Dataset analyses were conducted according to PARADIM's model-to-data approach, in which user code is executed on the platform such that data remains on premise.
RESULTS: LUCQUE currently comprises 1,678 LDCT baseline studies from 1,678 participants. Most studies were classified as Lung-RADS 2. A total of 1,776 pulmonary nodules and 60 cysts were annotated, with a median (interquartile range) volume of $89\,(56,\,159)\,\mathrm{mm}^3$ and $1,384\,(589,\,3793)\,\mathrm{mm}^3$ respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: Compared to publicly available LCS datasets, LUCQUE currently represents the largest accessible annotated real-world LCS dataset. Access to LUCQUE is provided via a model-to-data approach, enabling privacy-preserving, reproducible, and independent real-world evaluation of AI tools in LCS.
items.title_ko: LUCQUE: 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 평가를 위한 퀘벡 폐암 검진 데이터셋
items.summary_ko: LUCQUE는 AI 기반 폐암 검진 도구의 신뢰할 수 있는 평가를 위해 퀘벡 지역의 LDCT(저선량 흉부 CT) 폐암 검진 데이터를 기반으로 구축된 새롭고 광범위하게 주석이 달린 데이터셋입니다. 이는 AI 도구의 재현성, 비교 가능성 및 독립적인 평가를 촉진하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 개발 및 평가에 필요한 고품질 공개 데이터셋을 제공하여, 폐암 검진 AI의 발전과 신뢰성 확보에 기여합니다.

items.title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks
items.body: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.
items.title_ko: 분해 지침을 위한 자동화된 지식 습득 파이프라인: NLP와 생성형 AI 프레임워크 비교
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 비정형 정보 소스(예: 분해 매뉴얼)에서 분해 지침을 추출하기 위한 두 가지 프레임워크(규칙 기반 NLP 및 생성형 AI)를 비교합니다. 자연어 텍스트를 구조화된 기계 판독 가능한 형식으로 변환하여 순환 경제 및 Re-X 원칙에 기여하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 제조 및 재활용 산업에서 AI를 활용한 지식 관리 및 자동화의 가능성을 보여주며, 복잡한 제품의 분해 자동화를 위한 실용적인 접근법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
items.body: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.
items.title_ko: 역전이 없는 고차원 반사실 추론
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 관측 데이터, 모델 가정 및 인과 그래프를 기반으로 단위에 대한 가상 '만약-then' 질문에 답하는 반사실 추론(counterfactual inference) 작업을 다룹니다. 특히 고차원 변수에 대한 역전이 없는 접근법을 제안하여, 1차원 변수 중심의 기존 문헌을 확장합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 고차원 데이터에서 반사실적 질문에 답하는 능력을 향상시켜, 의사 결정 지원 시스템 및 AI 기반 시뮬레이션의 정확성을 높입니다.

items.title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
items.body: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.
items.title_ko: 길가의 챗봇: 의료 전문가, 보호자, 환자에게 LLM이 권장하는 정신 건강 개입 감사
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 41개의 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)이 의료 전문가, 보호자, 환자 등 세 가지 관점에서 동일한 정신 건강 질문에 대해 어떤 개입을 추천하는지 감사했습니다. 19개의 사례 시나리오와 5가지 질문을 통해 35,055개의 자유 텍스트 응답을 수집하고 분석했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 정신 건강 분야에서 제공하는 정보의 신뢰성과 안전성을 평가하는 중요한 연구로, AI 기반 의료 상담의 윤리적이고 실용적인 적용에 대한 논의를 촉진합니다.

items.title: 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling
items.body: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.
items.title_ko: 2D Gum-Net: 대칭 상관 및 스펙트럼 풀링을 통한 비지도 조밀 탄성 이미지 정합
items.summary_ko: 2D Gum-Net은 이미지 간의 픽셀 단위 변형 필드를 비지도 학습 방식으로 예측하는 종단 간 아키텍처입니다. 이는 실제 데이터에서 지상 진실 변형 필드를 얻기 어려운 문제점을 해결하며, 의료 영상 및 구조 생물학 분야에 활용될 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상 분석 등에서 핵심적인 이미지 정합(Image Registration) 기술을 데이터 라벨링 없이 학습할 수 있게 하여, AI 기반 영상 분석의 적용 범위를 넓힙니다.

items.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
items.body: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.
items.title_ko: Agentic-OPD: 에이전트 작업에 대한 온-정책 증류를 통해 잊혀진 에이전트 능력 복구
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 강화 학습(RL) 기반 LLM 에이전트 훈련 시 최적 검증 체크포인트만 보관하는 것이 정보를 손실할 수 있음을 보여줍니다. GRPO 훈련에서 이전 체크포인트가 해결했던 문제를 최적 체크포인트가 실패하는 경우가 있으며, 온-정책 증류(On-Policy Distillation)를 통해 잊혀진 에이전트 능력을 복구하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트 학습 과정에서 발생하는 '잊어버림' 문제를 해결하고, 여러 체크포인트의 지식을 효과적으로 통합하여 에이전트의 강건성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets
items.body: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.
items.title_ko: 스마트폰 기반 깊이 인식 투과 조명 이미징을 이용한 닭고기 근육병증 감지
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 스마트폰 기반의 투과 조명(transillumination) 및 3D 포인트 클라우드 프레임워크를 개발하여 닭고기 안심의 우디 브레스트(Woody Breast, WB) 근육병증 심각도를 비파괴적으로 분류합니다. 기존의 주관적이고 노동 집약적인 방법을 대체할 수 있는 효율적인 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 식품 산업에서 AI 기반 품질 검사의 자동화 및 효율성 향상에 기여하며, 소비자에게 더 안전하고 고품질의 제품을 제공할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

items.title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
items.body: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
items.body_ko: 효과적인 머신러닝 모델을 개발하려면 복잡한 수동 튜닝이 필요하며, 현재의 자동화된 머신러닝(AutoML) 프레임워크는 도메인 특화적이고 모델 아키텍처, 훈련 하이퍼파라미터, 데이터 비율 최적화를 분리합니다. 본 연구에서는 이 격차를 해소하기 위해 범용적인 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 기반 AutoML 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이 프레임워크는 작업별 미세 조정 없이 이러한 구성을 처음으로 동시에 최적화합니다. 우리는 다양한 AutoML 설계 선택을 범용적인 이산 시퀀스로 변환하고 최적화 프로세스를 통합된 순위 지정 작업으로 효과적으로 재구성하는 통합 수치 인코딩 방식인 NCode를 제안합니다. 제한된 단일 도메인 비전 작업에서 파생된 최적화 궤적만으로 훈련된 제안된 LLM 기반 탐색기는 인상적인 교차 작업, 교차 모달리티 및 공동 탐색 공간 최적화 일반화 가능성을 보여주며, 이미지 분류, 이미지 분할, 화자 확인 및 텍스트-이미지 벤치마크에서 최첨단 성능을 달성합니다. 특히, 수십억 개의 매개변수를 가진 Diffusion Transformer의 대규모 훈련 및 공동 최적화에서 뛰어난 확장성을 보여주며, 896 GPU-days가 소요되고 0.91의 최첨단 GenEval 점수를 달성합니다. 강화 학습을 활용하여 Chain-of-Thought 추론을 주입함으로써, LLM 기반 탐색기의 내부 의사 결정 메커니즘을 해석하는 체계적인 방법을 제공하여 최적화 전략이 초기 단계의 다양성 중심 탐색에서 후기 단계의 앵커 활용으로 전환되었음을 밝힙니다. 우리의 제안된 프레임워크는 범용적인 개방형 머신러닝 최적화를 향한 확장 가능하고 일반화 가능하며 해석 가능한 경로를 제공합니다.
items.title_ko: 오픈월드 자동화된 기계 학습을 위한 범용 탐색자로서의 대규모 언어 모델
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 범용 AutoML(Automated Machine Learning) 프레임워크의 탐색자(universal searcher)로 활용하는 NCode를 제안합니다. NCode는 모델 아키텍처, 훈련 하이퍼파라미터, 데이터 비율 최적화를 공동으로 수행하며, 특정 작업에 대한 미세 조정 없이 작동합니다.
items.why_ko: AutoML의 자동화 범위를 확장하여, 머신러닝 모델 개발 과정을 더욱 간소화하고 효율성을 높이는 혁신적인 접근법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
items.body: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git
items.title_ko: 매개변수가 아닌 행동에 앵커링: 단일 공유 프롬프트를 사용한 리허설 없는 연속 학습
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 단일 공유 프롬프트(single shared prompt)를 사용하여 리허설(rehearsal) 없이 연속 학습(continual learning)을 수행하는 방법을 제안합니다. 기존의 매개변수 공간에서 지식을 보호하는 방식 대신, 행동 공간에 앵커링하여 새로운 작업을 학습하면서도 이전 지식을 유지하는 방법을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 적은 매개변수로도 효율적인 연속 학습을 가능하게 하여, 자원 제약이 있는 환경에서 AI 모델의 지속적인 학습 및 적응 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion
items.body: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.
items.title_ko: LogCDM: 행동 그래프 드리프트 및 적응형 신호 융합을 통한 해석 가능한 로그 이상 탐지
items.summary_ko: LogCDM은 소규모 인과적 트랜스포머의 다음 이벤트 놀라움, 세션 전환 그래프의 그래프-어텐션 임베딩 거리, 이상 감지 시스템의 로그 패턴 드리프트 등 세 가지 상호 보완적인 신호를 사용하여 각 로그 세션을 평가하는 컴팩트한 이상 탐지기입니다. 이는 대규모 사전 훈련 모델 없이도 로그 이상을 탐지합니다.
items.why_ko: 로그 기반 이상 탐지 분야에서 대규모 모델의 자원 제약을 해결하고, 경량화된 모델로도 높은 성능과 해석 가능성을 제공하는 실용적인 솔루션을 제시합니다.

items.title: Learning Rate Decay Can Exponentially Accelerate SGD for Global Optimization of Nonconvex Functions
items.body: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is a workhorse algorithm for continuous optimization. It is a folk belief among deep learning practitioners that learning rate decay in SGD substantially improves performance. However, it has remained unclear whether learning rate decay offers an asymptotic advantage for global nonconvex optimization. We answer this question in the affirmative by demonstrating a natural class of nonconvex functions for which, we prove that SGD with learning rate decay requires exponentially fewer gradient queries for global optimization than SGD with any fixed learning rate in the small-step size regime. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first exponential advantage that has been demonstrated for learning rate decay. The class of functions we consider includes many popular benchmark nonconvex functions. Our results provide a robust explanatory theory for the empirically observed benefits of learning rate decay for global optimization. We show that annealing performs the non-logconcave sampling task associated to the optimization problem in polynomial time, via a novel application of weak Poincaré inequalities.
items.title_ko: 학습률 감소가 비볼록 함수의 전역 최적화를 위한 SGD를 기하급수적으로 가속화할 수 있다
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 학습률 감소(learning rate decay)가 SGD(확률적 경사 하강법)의 비볼록 함수 전역 최적화에 기하급수적인 속도 향상을 제공할 수 있음을 이론적으로 증명합니다. 이는 딥러닝 실무자들이 경험적으로 알고 있던 학습률 감소의 효과에 대한 이론적 근거를 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 딥러닝 모델의 최적화 효율성을 높이는 핵심적인 이론적 발견으로, 학습률 스케줄링 전략 개발에 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
items.body: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
items.title_ko: PORT: 로버스트 토큰 수준 재가중치를 통한 선호도 최적화
items.summary_ko: PORT(Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting)는 선호도 주석의 품질에 크게 의존하는 대규모 언어 모델 정렬의 문제를 해결합니다. 이 방법은 전체 응답을 균일하게 처리하는 대신 토큰 수준에서 재가중치를 적용하여, 노이즈가 있는 선호도 데이터에서도 강건하게 학습할 수 있도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: 인간 선호도 정렬 학습의 신뢰성을 높여, AI 모델이 인간의 가치에 더욱 효과적으로 부합하도록 돕는 중요한 기술 개선입니다.

items.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.body: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.
items.body_ko: 우리는 Sage-Taiyi를 소개합니다. 이는 축적된 과학적 이해를 사용하여 다음에 무엇을 조사하고 어떻게 조사할지 안내하는 메타인지에서 영감을 받은 아키텍처입니다. 명시적인 모니터링과 제어를 통해 시스템은 증거, 가정 및 미해결 질문에 대한 이해를 수정하고, 이러한 평가를 사용하여 연구 목표를 조정하고 재사용 가능한 추론 방법을 선택합니다. 10개 분야의 50개 논문에서 추출한 265개의 작업으로 구성된 AI 공동 과학자 아이디어 벤치마크인 Taiyi-Bench에서 Sage-Taiyi는 역사적 재발견 및 개방형 아이디어의 8가지 지표 모두에서 1위를 차지하여 가장 강력한 베이스라인인 AI Scientist-v2의 47.9점과 비교하여 54.0점의 전체 점수를 달성했습니다. 또한 두 가지 외부 과학 아이디어 벤치마크에서도 우수한 성능을 보였습니다. 5가지 전문가 주도 협업은 화학, 재료 과학 및 공학 전반에 걸쳐 제안을 실험 및 계산 검증과 연결했습니다. 화학 분야에서는 반응 조건 최적화를 통해 코발트 촉매 카르보닐화 수율이 미량에서 84%로, 광촉매 알릴 아민화 수율이 13%에서 69%로 증가했습니다. 이러한 결과는 과학적 아이디어 및 실제 검증으로의 진행에 대한 접근 방식으로 메타인지 조절을 지지합니다.
items.title_ko: Sage-Taiyi: 과학적 발견을 위한 메타인지 아키텍처
items.summary_ko: Sage-Taiyi는 축적된 과학적 이해를 바탕으로 다음 연구 대상을 결정하고 조사 방법을 안내하는 메타인지 기반 아키텍처입니다. 이 시스템은 증거, 가정, 미해결 질문에 대한 이해를 명시적으로 모니터링하고 제어하며, 이를 통해 연구 목표와 재사용 가능한 추론 방법을 조정합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 과학적 발견 과정의 효율성과 자율성을 크게 높일 수 있는 혁신적인 접근법을 제시하여, 연구 및 개발 분야에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

items.title: DeepChronos: Temporal Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Multi-Step Attack Detection
items.body: Modern cyber threats commonly unfold as multi-step attacks comprising temporally and causally related phases. Current defenses commonly follow a detect first and correlate later paradigm. Intrusion detection systems classify events independently, while downstream systems reconstruct attack progression from the resulting alerts or audit records. In this context, learning-based detectors learn attack-step dependencies implicitly as statistical regularities in the data and cannot guarantee that their predictions follow the real attack progression. Conversely, correlation systems represent attack relationships explicitly, but apply this knowledge only after the underlying attack observations have been detected. We present DEEPCHRONOS, a neuro-symbolic network intrusion detection system that shifts the paradigm from detect first and correlate later to detection through logical progression. DEEPCHRONOS combines learned flow-level evidence with explicit attack-phase rules, temporal prerequisites, and previously inferred phases, allowing the evolving attack history to inform and constrain each detection decision. Evaluations on DARPA 2000 and AIT-LDS V2 show that DEEPCHRONOS improves macro F1 over purely neural baselines by up to 11.3%, eliminates causal violations under strict temporal constraints, and maintains millisecond-scale inference latency. These results demonstrate that integrating explicit attack progression knowledge into detection produces more accurate and temporally coherent multi-step attack predictions.
items.title_ko: DeepChronos: 다단계 공격 탐지를 위한 시간적 신경-상징적 추론
items.summary_ko: DeepChronos는 시간적으로나 인과적으로 관련된 여러 단계로 구성된 다단계 사이버 공격을 탐지하기 위한 신경-상징적 추론 시스템입니다. 기존 방어 시스템이 개별 이벤트를 탐지한 후 상관관계를 분석하는 방식과 달리, DeepChronos는 공격 단계 의존성을 명시적으로 학습하고 보장합니다.
items.why_ko: 사이버 보안 분야에서 복잡한 다단계 공격을 더욱 효과적으로 탐지하고 방어할 수 있는 새로운 접근법을 제공하여, 시스템 보안을 강화합니다.

items.title: From Granger causality to causal structure in dynamical systems
items.body: The idea of testing whether the past of one signal improves the prediction of another can be traced back to Wiener. It was Granger who formalized the concept. Granger causality has become one of the most widely used tools to infer directed interactions between the components of a system. The name however can be misleading: it detects predictive relations among the measured signals, not causal relations among the mechanisms that generate them. This article starts by reviewing recent advances in observation-space Granger analysis. It then follows a path to directed structure in latent dynamical models, and asks under which conditions that structure can be read causally.
items.title_ko: 그랜저 인과성에서 동적 시스템의 인과 구조로
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 위너(Wiener)와 그랜저(Granger)의 인과성 개념을 재조명하며, 한 신호의 과거가 다른 신호의 예측을 개선하는지 여부를 테스트하는 그랜저 인과성이 측정된 신호 간의 예측 관계를 탐지할 뿐, 근본적인 메커니즘 간의 인과 관계를 나타내지는 않음을 설명합니다.
items.why_ko: 시계열 데이터에서 인과 관계를 추론하는 데 사용되는 그랜저 인과성의 한계를 명확히 하고, 실제 인과 구조를 이해하기 위한 더 깊은 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.
items.title_ko: 내러티브 격차: LLM이 언어 전반의 다양한 내러티브를 탐색하는 데 도움이 될 수 있는가?
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 LLM이 언어와 지역에 따라 다른 내러티브를 탐색하는 데 어떻게 도움이 될 수 있는지 탐구합니다. 다양한 다국어 정보 탐색에 필요한 여섯 가지 역량을 정의하고, 경쟁하는 내러티브를 모델이 어떻게 처리할 수 있는지에 대한 질문을 던집니다.
items.why_ko: 대규모 언어 모델이 다국어 및 문화적 맥락에서 정보 불균형을 해소하고, 다양한 관점을 이해하는 데 중요한 역할을 할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Clique Constraints for Exact Causal Structure Learning
items.body: Exact score-based causal structure learning supports explicit structural constraints and optimisation certificates, but its branch-and-cut search can be computationally demanding. We augment exact causal structure learning methods with an upper bound on the maximum clique size of the learned undirected skeleton, enforced at integer candidates through lazy cycle and clique constraints. On static linear-Gaussian Erdős-Rényi and scale-free DAGs, we evaluate callback order, alternative clique-cut policies, incumbent repair, fractional separation, and Big-M bounds. We report causal-recovery metrics jointly with optimality gaps, primal and dual bounds, node throughput, MIPSOL events, and callback cost. Two variants receive particular attention: B3 selects the most violated minimal (k+1)-clique inequality at each callback, whereas C3 repairs an infeasible integer candidate by deleting violating edges and refitting affected regression columns using QR-based least squares. The results do not indicate that clique constraints uniformly accelerate optimisation. However, their benefit depends on graph density, sample size, and cut-management policy, while large collections of correlated constraints can reduce node throughput. Tighter valid Big-M bounds reduced the fixed-budget optimality gap in most tested settings, without necessarily changing SHD or F1 at a fixed time limit. These findings characterize the computational trade-offs of clique-constrained exact causal learning, and identify selective separation and incumbent repair as promising directions.
items.title_ko: 정확한 인과 구조 학습을 위한 클리크 제약 조건
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 정확한 점수 기반 인과 구조 학습(score-based causal structure learning)의 계산 비용 문제를 해결하기 위해 학습된 무방향성 스켈레톤의 최대 클리크 크기에 대한 상한을 도입합니다. 지연된 사이클 및 클리크 제약 조건을 통해 정수 후보에서 이를 강제합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 시스템의 인과 관계를 정확하게 모델링하는 데 필요한 계산 효율성을 향상시켜, 인과 추론 분야의 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Inference Validation for Regulated AI: Building a Decision Pipeline on NVIDIA AIPerf
items.body: Deploying large language models in regulated industries requires more than picking the fastest inference engine: it requires evidence that a configuration meets contractual and legal obligations before it serves a single customer request. We describe Runway, an internal validation harness built at MasterControl that builds a governed decision pipeline around NVIDIA AIPerf. The key insight is separating concerns: AIPerf provides the trusted measurement, while Runway provides the experiment design that comes before it and the compliance, cost, and audit decisions that come after. We describe the architecture and the storage model that makes caching and audit one mechanism. We report three findings from Runway sweeps: TensorRT-LLM and vLLM rankings invert with concurrency; a newer, pricier GPU instance can be the cheaper one per request; and speculative decoding behaves differently across engines under load, so engine configuration can outweigh engine choice.
items.title_ko: 규제 AI를 위한 추론 검증: NVIDIA AIPerf 기반 의사 결정 파이프라인 구축
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 규제 산업에서 LLM을 배포할 때 가장 빠른 추론 엔진을 선택하는 것을 넘어, 계약 및 법적 의무를 충족하는지에 대한 증거를 확보하는 의사 결정 파이프라인(Runway) 구축 방법을 설명합니다. NVIDIA AIPerf를 활용하여 신뢰할 수 있는 측정과 실험 설계를 분리합니다.
items.why_ko: 규제 산업에서 AI 모델의 신뢰성, 규정 준수 및 성능을 보장하기 위한 실용적인 검증 파이프라인 구축 가이드라인을 제공합니다.

items.title: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
items.body: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.
items.title_ko: $Σ$-LeWM: S-정보를 통한 로봇 제어를 위한 세계 모델 학습
items.summary_ko: $Σ$-LeWM(Learning World Models via S-Information)은 로봇 제어를 위한 모델 기반 제어 방법으로, 세계 모델 학습에 S-정보를 활용합니다. 기존 세계 모델 아키텍처가 디코더에 의존했던 것과 달리, 이 모델은 잠재적 순방향 동역학 예측기와 안정화 엔트로피 항만을 사용하여 예측 가능한 잠재 공간을 학습하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 제어를 위한 세계 모델 학습의 효율성과 예측 가능성을 높여, 로봇 공학 분야에서 모델 기반 강화 학습의 실제 적용 가능성을 확장합니다.

items.title: KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers
items.body: Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm across depth, width, batch size, and training budget. Ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.
items.title_ko: KiteNorm: 안정적이고 확장 가능한 Post-LN 트랜스포머를 위한 분산 정규화
items.summary_ko: KiteNorm은 Post-LayerNorm 트랜스포머의 안정성과 확장성 문제를 해결하기 위해 분산 정규화(variance regularisation)를 제안합니다. 기존 Post-LN 방법이 초기화 시 안정성을 개선하는 데 중점을 두었지만, 높은 학습률에서 성능 저하를 보이는 문제를 해결하여, 강력한 Pre-LayerNorm 기준선을 능가하는 성능을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 트랜스포머 모델의 안정성과 깊이 확장을 위한 중요한 기술적 개선으로, 대규모 언어 모델의 훈련 효율성과 성능 향상에 기여합니다.

items.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
items.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
items.title_ko: 다단계 임상 에이전트를 위한 안전한 강화 학습: 밀집 보상이 결과 보상을 능가할 때
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 검증 가능한 보상을 사용하는 강화 학습이 언어 모델 추론을 개선하는 데 사용될 때, 다단계 임상 에이전트의 순차적 의사 결정 절차에 미치는 영향을 탐구합니다. 밀집 보상(dense rewards)이 최종 결과 보상(outcome rewards)보다 더 효과적일 수 있음을 보여주며, 세 가지 통제된 환경(약물 리필, 급성 진단, 투여량 조정)을 통해 이를 검증합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 분야에서 AI 에이전트의 안전하고 효과적인 의사 결정을 위한 강화 학습 설계에 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, 특히 보상 설계의 중요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints
items.body:
Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.
We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.
We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.
items.title_ko: OptiCover: 의미론적 제약 하에 콜드 스타트 시각 최적화를 위한 확장 가능하고 다중 표면 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: OptiCover는 전자상거래 시장의 시각적 머천다이징에서 효과적인 커버 사진을 선택하는 문제를 해결하기 위한 프레임워크입니다. 이 모델은 engagement 라벨이 없는 콜드 스타트 상황과 다양한 제품 표면에서 손님 선호도 변화에 대응하여, 이미지 생성을 통한 시각적 최적화를 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 전자상거래에서 AI 기반 시각적 콘텐츠 최적화의 어려움을 해결하고, 콜드 스타트 문제를 극복하여 매출 증대 및 사용자 경험 향상에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal
items.body:
Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs.
We present Generative Labeling On Clusters (GLOC) as a solution to provide highly scalable, cost-effective, low latency, and high accuracy online image insight services. GLOC leverages highly optimized image embeddings to form image clusters that are semantically close to each other for the purpose of the type of insights, and summarizes the insights at the cluster level, which effectively generalizes to members in the cluster. At Pinterest, GLOC powers image descriptors and pivot query suggestions for Hybrid Search, which is a multimodal search service enabling users to search with both an image and a text query. Our offline and online A/B tests demonstrate that GLOC significantly outperforms previous methods, delivering improvements in quality and efficiency.
items.title_ko: 생성형 AI를 통한 분류 체계 없는 이미지 라벨링 확장: 멀티모달 접근법
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 생성형 AI를 활용하여 실시간 멀티모달 이미지 인사이트를 제공하는 분류 체계 없는(taxonomy-free) 이미지 라벨링 방법을 제안합니다. 낮은 지연 시간, 높은 설명 정확도, 확장 가능하며 비용 효율적인 솔루션을 목표로 하여, 이미지에서 '지구색조', '리넨 바지'와 같은 아이디어를 생성합니다.
items.why_ko: 이미지 인식 및 라벨링 분야에서 생성형 AI의 활용 가능성을 높여, 전통적인 분류 체계의 한계를 극복하고 유연하고 확장 가능한 솔루션을 제공합니다.

items.title: Hidden Tails: Certifying Tail-Risk Claims under Selective Labels
items.body: Historical decisions determine which outcomes are observed, potentially concealing a predictor's largest errors. Even unlimited data from the same observation process can therefore leave population tail risk unresolved. Here we derive sharp bounds on conditional value-at-risk, the average loss in a specified upper tail, for binary outcomes and bounded losses. These bounds span exactly the risks compatible with the observations and a stated limit on how outcome odds differ between observed and hidden cases at the same covariate values. Under stated regularity conditions, calibrated statistical certificates cover these ranges simultaneously across candidate predictors, supporting risk limits and model comparisons while separating statistical uncertainty from persistent ambiguity. For a fixed predictor and loss threshold, we derive a minimum-cost allocation for reducing excess-loss ambiguity by prioritizing hidden outcomes according to ambiguity removed per unit cost. This allocation treats audited population contributions as known and retains the original sensitivity bounds separately for audited and still-hidden outcomes. In controlled masking experiments with known loan repayments, recovering about 16% of hidden labels removes a median 61% of estimated fixed-threshold ambiguity, compared with 16% for random recovery. These results connect population tail-risk claims to the available evidence and identify where additional outcomes can sharpen their assessment.
items.title_ko: 숨겨진 꼬리: 선택적 라벨링 하에 꼬리 위험(Tail-Risk) 주장 인증
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 역사적 결정이 관찰되는 결과를 결정하여 예측기의 가장 큰 오류를 숨길 수 있음을 지적합니다. 이 문제에 대한 해결책으로, 이분형 결과와 유한 손실에 대한 조건부 위험 가치(conditional value-at-risk)의 상한선을 도출하여, 관찰된 위험과 숨겨진 위험 간의 호환성을 보장합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 예측 오류, 특히 '꼬리 위험'을 정량화하고 관리하는 데 중요한 이론적 틀을 제공하여, 모델의 신뢰성 및 안전성을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
items.body:
Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision.
Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals.
Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision.
Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI.
Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.
items.title_ko: 임상 텍스트 비식별화를 위한 규칙 기반 및 신경 탐지기가 계층화된 로컬 언어 모델: 오픈소스 툴킷 및 평가
items.summary_ko: DeidSharp는 규칙, 임상 개체명 인식(NER) 모델, 로컬 26B MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) LLM을 결합하여 임상 텍스트에서 민감한 건강 정보(PHI)를 비식별화하는 오픈소스 .NET 툴킷입니다. 이 연구는 기존 도구보다 더 많은 PHI를 정밀하게 찾아내는지 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 데이터의 프라이버시 보호 및 보안을 위한 효율적이고 정확한 비식별화 솔루션을 제공하며, 오픈소스 생태계에 기여합니다.

items.title: Multi-Agent Screening: What Agreement and Acceptance Cannot Tell You
items.body: When AI agents screen items for a costly human assessor, as in agentic search, e-discovery and AI reviewing of papers, only what they pass gets judged. We show what each kind of evidence can establish about their errors, even with unlimited data. Agreement shows that agents concur, not that they are right, however many there are. Acceptance by the assessor gives precision but only a lower bound on recall. Knowing which agents found which relevant items gives an upper bound on recall if agents' finds are not negatively correlated, and caps what one more agent can add if agents are interchangeable. Without assumptions about the agents, recall can be pinned down only by judging items they did not pass: a random sample of these estimates how many relevant items were missed, to any chosen accuracy, and the sample needed does not grow with the number of agents.
items.title_ko: 멀티 에이전트 스크리닝: 합의와 수용만으로는 알 수 없는 것
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 AI 에이전트가 항목을 스크리닝하고 인간 평가자에게 전달할 때, 합의(agreement)와 수용(acceptance)만으로는 에이전트의 오류를 완전히 파악할 수 없음을 보여줍니다. 에이전트가 어떤 관련 항목을 발견했는지 아는 것이 리콜(recall)에 대한 상한선을 제공한다는 것을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 멀티 에이전트 시스템의 평가 및 감사 방법에 대한 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, AI 에이전트의 실제 성능과 한계를 이해하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits
items.body: Accurate classifiers can fail when background cues change without altering the correct labels. Predictive performance alone does not quantify how much task information remains after accounting for such nuisance variation. Here we extend the Fisher-glass framework to connect nuisance-adjusted information with local classification difficulty and subpopulation auditing. We derive lower bounds on local minimax excess classification risk under explicit distinguishability and decision-separation conditions, alongside statistical audits accounting for estimation error and regularization. On Waterbirds, a feature-based diagnostic of task-background alignment selects an accurately classified group, with selection frozen before held-out evaluation. Across five training seeds, background replacements preserving the extracted bird foreground and labels yield 93.2% accuracy when background type is preserved and 40.6% when it changes, a controlled difference of 52.6 percentage points. Separately, search using task labels and a fixed nuisance direction identifies an independently evaluated population with 98.8% membership-weighted accuracy and low estimated projected predictive Fisher information. Training and acquisition experiments show that information gains and predictive gains can diverge. These findings support joint assessment of predictive performance, information under declared nuisance models and controlled sensitivity when diagnosing vulnerability and evaluating model improvements.
items.title_ko: Fisher-Glass 학습: 분류 경계 및 서브집단 감사
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 Fisher-glass 프레임워크를 확장하여 배경 단서가 변경되어도 정답 레이블이 변하지 않는 상황에서 분류기의 실패를 분석합니다. 방해 변수(nuisance variation)를 조정한 후에도 작업 정보가 얼마나 남아있는지 정량화하고, 국부 최소 최대 분류 위험(local minimax excess classification risk)에 대한 하한을 도출합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 분류 모델의 강건성과 공정성을 평가하는 새로운 방법을 제시하며, 특히 서브집단에 대한 모델 성능 감사에 중요한 이론적 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering
items.body: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/
items.title_ko: GeoScope: 초고해상도 원격 감지 질의 응답을 위한 카운팅 한계 이상의 훈련 없는 프로그램 실행
items.summary_ko: GeoScope는 초고해상도 원격 감지 이미지에서 VLM(비전-언어 모델)이 객체를 정확하게 카운팅하고 공간적 관계를 이해하는 데 실패하는 문제를 해결합니다. 기존 VLM의 카운팅 한계를 측정하고, 훈련 없이 프로그램 실행을 통해 이 한계를 극복하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 원격 감지 분야에서 VLM의 정확도를 향상시키고, 특히 객체 카운팅과 같은 정량적 분석에서 AI의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes
items.body: Not all mistakes are alike. For example, in medical diagnosis, false positive and false negative mistakes have a different impact and should not be aggregated. By revisiting the classical theory of boosting through this lens, we introduce the notion of $Z$-learner, which returns weak hypotheses achieving joint false-positive/false-negative guarantees $(\mathrm{FP},\mathrm{FN})$ from some set $Z \subseteq [0,1]^2$. This formulation generalizes the standard notion of $γ$-weak learning--recovered by taking $Z=\{(z_1,z_2): z_1+z_2<1/2-γ\}$--and allows for more flexible notions of weak learnability that account for the impact of the distribution on the achievable learning guarantees. This raises a natural question: which sets $Z$ are boostable? We answer this by giving a complete geometric characterization that unifies, as special cases, both the classical boosting dichotomy and the recent multi-objective extension of Bressan et al. (COLT 2025). We also present an adaptive algorithm for boosting $Z$-learners without relying on the prior knowledge of $Z$, generalizing AdaBoost's ability to handle unknown margin parameters. Finally, we demonstrate that $Z$-learners can achieve confidence amplification. However, the analysis is significantly more involved than in classical boosting and relies on the centerpoint theorem from discrete and computational geometry.
items.title_ko: 일반화된 적응형 부스팅과 실수(Mistakes)의 기하학
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 부스팅(boosting)의 고전적 이론을 재해석하여 $Z$-학습자(Z-learner) 개념을 도입합니다. $Z$-학습자는 약한 가설을 반환하여 공동 거짓 양성/음성 보증(FP, FN)을 달성하며, 모든 실수가 같지 않다는 관점을 통해 의료 진단과 같은 분야에서 실수 유형별 영향의 중요성을 강조합니다.
items.why_ko: 기계 학습 알고리즘의 오류 처리에 대한 새로운 시각을 제공하며, 특히 특정 유형의 오류가 치명적인 분야에서 모델의 신뢰성과 안전성을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: TACTUS: A Robotic Palpation System for Spatially Heterogeneous Hardness Mapping of Woody Breast Myopathy
items.body: Woody breast (WB) myopathy is a spatially heterogeneous fibro-degenerative condition of the broiler Pectoralis major muscle. Existing mechanical reference methods rely on single-point or sequential compression measurements, limiting characterization of spatial hardness variability. This study presents TACTUS (Tactile Adaptive Conformal 3D Uniform Sensing), an automated tactile array that generates thickness-normalized, three-dimensional hardness maps at 20 anatomically distributed locations within approximately 30 s. TACTUS integrates 20 independently motorized tactuators with force-sensing resistors and encoder-driven linear actuators, alongside a LiDAR depth camera for surface profiling and adaptive compression. The system was evaluated using 100 broiler breast fillets across four WB severity classes (Normal, Mild, Moderate, Severe). TACTUS identified significant force differences among severity classes (ANOVA, p < 0.001), with the strongest differentiation in the cranial region and a significant caudal effect not detected by texture-analyzer measurements. Fillet-level TACTUS force showed moderate but significant correlation with texture-analyzer measurements (Pearson r = 0.441, p < 0.001). Semivariogram, local change entropy, and heterogeneity analyses revealed increasing and anatomically structured hardness variability with WB severity. These findings demonstrate TACTUS as an automated, operator-independent platform for spatially resolved mechanical characterization and ground-truth generation to support hyperspectral and near-infrared spectroscopy-based WB classification systems.
items.title_ko: TACTUS: 우디 브레스트 근육병증의 공간적으로 이질적인 경도 매핑을 위한 로봇 촉진 시스템
items.summary_ko: TACTUS는 브로일러 닭의 우디 브레스트(WB) 근육병증을 진단하기 위한 자동화된 촉각 배열 시스템입니다. 이 시스템은 두께 정규화된 3차원 경도 맵을 생성하여 WB 근육병증의 공간적 이질성을 정량적으로 특성화합니다. 기존의 단일 지점 또는 순차적 압축 측정의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 식품 품질 검사 분야에서 AI 기반 로봇 시스템을 활용하여, 육류 근육병증과 같은 품질 결함을 더욱 정확하고 객관적으로 진단할 수 있는 가능성을 제시합니다.

items.title: Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning
items.body:
We study the problem of binary classification in the marginal-nonuniform learning framework in the agnostic setting. In this model, the constants in the learning rate may depend on the marginal distribution of the unlabeled data, but the guarantee must hold uniformly over all conditional distributions of the labels. We also study fine-grained rates.
We consider two criteria.
(1) The standard agnostic setting, where the learner competes with the best concept in the class. In this setting, an immediate consequence of standard agnostic PAC learning results gives us the optimal rate of $\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ for every class $\mathcal{H}$ with finite $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ and shows that arbitrarily slow rates are necessary otherwise. This also gives us the optimal fine-grained rate of $\sqrt{\tfrac{\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})}{n}}$. Therefore, the dependence on the marginal distribution does not help, which is in contrast to the realizable setting.
(2) In the relaxed agnostic setting, where the learner competes with $(1+λ)$ times the error of the best concept for a fixed $λ\in (0,1]$, the picture from the realizable setting reappears. We obtain a trichotomy of the achievable optimal rates: exponential rates of the form $e^{-n}$ arise precisely when the class is finite; linear rates of the form $\tfrac{1}{n}$ arise when the class is infinite but $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ is finite; and arbitrarily slow rates occur when $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})=\infty$. We also obtain the optimal fine-grained rate of $\tfrac{\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})}{λn}$, where $\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})$ is a recently introduced combinatorial complexity dimension called the uncentered $\mathrm{VC}$-eluder dimension.
items.title_ko: 비동질적인 주변 분포를 위한 비판적 학습(Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning)
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 비동질적인 주변 분포 학습(marginal-nonuniform learning) 프레임워크에서 이진 분류 문제를 다룹니다. 이 모델에서 학습 속도의 상수는 라벨링되지 않은 데이터의 주변 분포에 의존하지만, 라벨의 모든 조건부 분포에 대해 보증이 균일하게 유지되어야 합니다.
items.why_ko: 다양한 데이터 분포 환경에서 기계 학습 모델의 일반화 성능을 이해하고 개선하는 데 중요한 이론적 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
items.body: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.
items.title_ko: 격자 기반 HMM 접근법을 이용한 오스만 시의 아루즈 운율 분석
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 오스만 디완 시의 아루즈 운율(아랍어 스크립트 기반의 음절 가중치 운율)을 자동으로 찾아내고 스캔션 정렬을 수행하기 위한 격자 기반 HMM(Hidden Markov Model) 접근법을 제안합니다. 특히 현대 터키어 철자에서도 이 작업을 수행하는 데 중점을 둡니다.
items.why_ko: 자연어 처리 분야에서 고대 문학의 운율 분석과 같은 복잡한 문화유산 연구에 AI를 적용하는 새로운 가능성을 제시합니다.

items.title: Average versus expected causal effects under interference: Modeling assumptions and estimation bottlenecks
items.body: Causal inference under treatment interference requires assumptions to reduce the exponentially large number of potential outcomes. We develop hierarchical finite-population models for potential outcomes by separating these assumptions into three layers: interference neighborhoods, exposure mappings, and outcome models. Given an interference neighborhood and exposure mapping, we show that potential outcomes admit a nonparametric decomposition into direct, spillover, and treatment--spillover interaction components. This decomposition provides a common coordinate system for nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric models of finite-population potential outcomes. For a given potential-outcome model, we define two classes of estimands. Average causal effects (ACEs), such as direct and total treatment effects, contrast potential outcomes under fixed treatment--exposure conditions. Expected causal effects (ECEs), such as expected direct and indirect effects, contrast expectations of potential outcomes under a specified allocation policy. For both classes, we bound the variance of the canonical Horvitz--Thompson estimator by three terms: a diagonal weight term, a term from overlapping interference neighborhoods, and a residual design-dependence term. Our upper and lower bounds show that under graph-unaware designs, nonparametric design-unbiased estimation of ACEs can require sample sizes growing exponentially in the interference degree, whereas polynomial growth can suffice for design-aligned ECEs. Under neighborhood interference, we construct graph-aware independent-set designs with variance bounds polynomial in the maximum degree for direct and total treatment effects on every graph, whereas graph cluster randomization can incur worst-case variance exponential in the degree.
items.title_ko: 간섭 하의 평균 대 예상 인과 효과: 모델링 가정 및 추정 병목 현상
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 치료 간섭(treatment interference) 하에서의 인과 추론 문제를 다룹니다. 잠재적 결과에 대한 계층적 유한 모집단 모델을 개발하여 간섭 이웃, 노출 매핑, 결과 모델 등 세 가지 계층으로 가정을 분리하고, 잠재적 결과가 직접, 파급, 치료-파급 상호작용으로 비모수적으로 분해됨을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 사회과학, 경제학, 의료 등 다양한 분야에서 간섭 효과를 고려한 인과 추론의 정확성을 높이는 데 중요한 이론적 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation
items.body: Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. The benchmark asks models to predict coils conditioned on a target equilibrium and requirements on coil-coil and coil-plasma spacing, curvature, and magnetic-field error. We show that magnetic-field accuracy remains the main challenge, with learned models rarely satisfying all requirements simultaneously. However, using learned predictions to initialize conventional coil optimization can accelerate early progress. We release baseline models and evaluation code to support reproducible research on both direct coil generation and learned optimization initializations. By lowering the barrier for machine learning and optimization researchers to engage with stellarator coil design, we aim to accelerate progress toward practical, cost-effective stellarator power plants.
items.title_ko: CoilStellaration: 공학적 인식을 고려한 스텔러레이터 코일셋 생성을 위한 데이터셋 및 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: CoilStellaration은 핵융합 장치인 스텔러레이터의 코일 설계 문제를 해결하기 위한 데이터셋 및 벤치마크입니다. 이 연구는 외부에서 생성된 3차원 자기장을 재현하면서도 공학적 제약 조건을 만족하는 코일 지오메트리를 찾는 비선형 역문제 해결에 중점을 둡니다.
items.why_ko: 핵융합 연구 분야에서 AI를 활용한 복잡한 공학 설계 최적화의 가능성을 제시하며, 에너지 문제 해결에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: reComposer: Editable Planning for Controllable Image Generation
items.body: Prompt-based image generation makes it easy to produce visual assets, but offers little support for engaging with the creative process. Prompting collapses interdependent creative decisions into a monolithic instruction and returns a finished image, leaving control limited to revising the prompt or correcting the model's output. We present reComposer, a process-oriented image-generation interface built around editable planning, which decomposes users' evolving intent into meaningful creative decisions - such as subject, composition, or palette - and collaborates with users to explore underspecified goals and alternatives. reComposer supports conversational and direct manipulation of the plan, moving between concept-level intent and visual-level control. We evaluated reComposer with 8 design and non-design professionals. Compared to prompting, participants felt greater control and ownership while developing visual assets, exploring alternatives, and iterating on details. Our findings suggest how shifting generative AI interaction from specifying outputs to shaping process can support creative thinking alongside asset production.
items.title_ko: reComposer: 제어 가능한 이미지 생성을 위한 편집 가능한 계획
items.summary_ko: reComposer는 프롬프트 기반 이미지 생성의 한계를 극복하기 위해 편집 가능한 계획(editable planning)을 중심으로 구축된 과정 지향적 이미지 생성 인터페이스입니다. 이는 사용자 의도를 의미 있는 창의적 결정으로 분해하여, 프롬프트 수정이나 모델 출력 보정 이상의 제어 기능을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성형 AI의 이미지 생성 과정에서 사용자의 창의적 제어력을 높여, 단순한 프롬프팅을 넘어선 심층적인 협업 경험을 제공합니다.

items.title: A four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: a body composition case study
items.body:
Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) lack prognostic biomarkers, and computed tomography (CT)-based body composition radiomics at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) is a promising candidate. Small cohorts make high-dimensional radiomic models prone to overfitting and single-split evaluations variable and optimistic.
This methodological study proposes a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: (1) false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected feature selection, (2) a dual-path comparison of prior feature selection versus embedded regularization, (3) repeated nested cross-validation (CV) and (4) a negative control with Gaussian noise features. In 78 GEP-NET patients, 535 radiomic features from five L3 compartments were used to evaluate five survival models with Harrell's concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) and integrated Brier score (IBS).
Step 1 selected at least one feature in 18% of outer folds under noise (nominal level 20%) versus 84% with radiomic features. The dual-path comparison showed no consistent difference between strategies. Repeated nested CV reduced variability across seeds (41% median reduction in C-index standard deviation), but not enough to distinguish models. The nested CV C-index exceeded chance by 0.07-0.15 with radiomic features but not clearly under noise (0.40-0.42 with prior feature selection, 0.47-0.55 with embedded regularization). Frequently selected features tentatively linked greater subcutaneous fat, skeletal muscle compactness and texture to better prognosis.
These findings suggest a modest prognostic signal in L3 radiomics, with considerable uncertainty that the protocol quantifies. The protocol may transfer to other small-cohort radiomic survival studies. Code: https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol.
items.title_ko: 소규모 코호트에서 방사선학적 생존 분석을 위한 4단계 검증 프로토콜: 신체 구성 사례 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 소규모 코호트에서 방사선학적 생존 분석(radiomic survival analysis)을 위한 4단계 검증 프로토콜을 제안합니다. 고차원 방사선학적 모델이 과적합되기 쉬운 문제와 단일 분할 평가의 가변성을 해결하기 위한 FDR(False Discovery Rate) 보정 특징 선택 등을 포함합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상 데이터를 활용한 예후 예측 모델의 신뢰성을 높여, 소규모 데이터셋 환경에서도 AI 기반 진단 및 예후 예측의 정확성을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model
items.body: A world model predicts how a scene changes after an action, and a planner uses it to search for actions that reach a goal. If the camera moves or the controller changes, the same command moves the robot differently: when its commands are turned by 90 degrees, a frozen planner with the LeWM world model that succeeds in 77.5% of episodes succeeds in only 7.8%. Current fixes retrain the model, need training data, or forget a set-up when it returns. We propose Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects only the map from commands to applied actions, which we call the hand. LoH reads the hand through the frozen model, with no extra sensor: it finds the action that best explains the change between two camera images (a reading). It stores every hand it identifies, so a returning set-up is recognised rather than re-learnt. In closed-loop tests, LoH more than doubles success on three simulated tasks, from 28.6% to 62.3%, and loses only 0.6 percentage points when nothing changes. It also works, unchanged, with two other world models and on two of three models pretrained on real robot data, and its gain grows with the quality of its readings.
items.title_ko: Library of Hands: 세계 모델이 아닌 손을 고쳐라
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 로봇 제어에서 카메라 이동이나 컨트롤러 변경 시 발생하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 세계 모델(world model)을 재훈련하는 대신, 'Library of Hands (LoH)'라는 훈련 없는 접근법을 제안합니다. LoH는 로봇의 명령을 다른 방식으로 해석하는 상황에서도 계획이 목표에 도달할 수 있도록 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 학습 시스템의 강건성을 향상시키고, 다양한 환경 변화에 유연하게 대처할 수 있는 효율적인 적응 메커니즘을 제공합니다.

items.title: VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
items.body: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.
items.title_ko: 실제 및 시뮬레이션 데이터로 VLA 적응: 로봇 체스 사례 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 로봇 체스와 같은 작업에서 VLA(Vision-Language-Action) 모델을 실제 및 시뮬레이션 데이터로 적응시키는 문제를 탐구합니다. 모델 미세 조정에 필요한 데이터 양, 훈련 업데이트, 체크포인트 선택, 시뮬레이션 활용 방안 등을 심층적으로 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 학습 분야에서 실제 데이터 수집의 높은 비용 문제를 해결하고, 시뮬레이션 데이터를 효과적으로 활용하여 모델의 적응력을 높이는 실용적인 지침을 제공합니다.

items.title: Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific
items.body: Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.
items.title_ko: 해석 가능성은 모델에 국한되지 않는다
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 해석 가능성 도구(예: 거부 방향, 진실성 탐침, 조향 벡터)가 특정 모델에 국한되지 않고, 레이블 없는 프롬프트에만 맞춰진 잔여 스트림(residual streams) 간의 맵을 통해 다른 모델로 전이될 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 5개 패밀리의 110쌍 모델 간에 이러한 도구의 전이 가능성을 테스트했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 해석 가능성이 특정 모델에 종속되지 않을 수 있음을 시사하며, 이는 범용적인 해석 도구 개발의 가능성을 열어 AI 모델 개발의 효율성을 높입니다.

items.title: Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
items.body: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.
items.title_ko: 제어된 이진 할당 흐름
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 그래프의 이진 데이터 레이블링을 위한 시간 가변 파라미터화된 깊은 할당 흐름(deep assignment flows)의 표현 및 학습에 대한 기하학적 접근법을 소개합니다. 각 에지는 2차원 완전히 측지선 부분다양체(totally geodesic submanifold)에서 최적으로 제어되는 파라미터 흐름을 전달합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 데이터에서의 이진 분류 및 할당 문제에 대한 새로운 기하학적 접근법을 제시하여, 복잡한 데이터 구조 분석에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Trade Promotion Optimisation for Consumer Goods
items.body: Trade promotions consume a large share of consumer-goods revenue, yet most planners still set discounts with a single, often unreliable, price elasticity per item. We present an end-to-end Trade Promotion Optimisation (TPO) system built as one chain: analogue SKUs, point elasticity, elasticity curve, price recommendation, promotional lift and net lift. Elasticity is measured at post-promo time from directional price-dip events against a rolling regular price, and at promo time by a causal estimator that residualises trend, seasonality and promotion, handles stock-out censoring with a Tobit likelihood and updates itself from the first clean promotion week. Items with weak evidence borrow the point elasticity and the curvature from analogue SKUs chosen by a cross-validated ridge model over category, brand, sub-category, price line and description. The optimiser separates self-price lift from substitution and post-promo dips and adjusts for inventory and trade funding. In a four-week promotion experiment on a 39-SKU consumer brand (mean elasticity -3.06), the plan lifts units by 20.6% and revenue by 6.9% at flat margin. Analogue pooling halves elasticity error relative to hierarchy averaging.
items.title_ko: 소비재의 무역 진흥 최적화
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 소비재 산업에서 무역 진흥 최적화(TPO)를 위한 종단 간 시스템을 제시합니다. SKU(재고 관리 단위) 유사성, 포인트 탄력성, 탄력성 곡선, 가격 추천, 프로모션 리프트 및 순 리프트를 포함하는 하나의 체인으로 구축됩니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 마케팅 및 가격 전략 최적화를 통해 소비재 기업의 수익성을 높이고, 경쟁 환경에서 효과적인 의사 결정을 지원합니다.

items.title: Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions
items.body: Routing a melanoma case to routine follow-up is a serious action error that diagnostic coverage alone does not rule out. We present Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (HC-ROCP), a training-free framework that uses frozen classifier probabilities and adds a harm penalty when choosing prediction sets and actions. We test the resulting policies on disjoint calibration splits with multiplicity adjustment. HC-ROCP certifies supported claims, reports descriptive fallback policies, and refuses unsupported subgroup claims. We evaluate these outputs retrospectively on COVID-19 radiographs, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and EyePACS-to-APTOS retinopathy transfer. Across ten calibration seeds, HC-ROCP reduces COVID-19 severe-action errors from the exact risk-optimal baseline's 4.68\% to 0.54\%. At a 5\% budget, global claims are certified for COVID-19 and ISIC, but the rare squamous-cell-carcinoma claim is refused. At 1\%, all settings receive descriptive reports. For each budget, we also report the minimum severe-case count needed to pass the global harm gate with zero errors, providing a starting point for further data collection.
items.title_ko: 인증, 보고 또는 거부: 임상 조치를 위한 피해 제약형 등각 예측
