items.summary_ko: HC-ROCP(Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction)는 냉동 분류기 확률을 사용하여 예측 집합 및 조치를 선택할 때 피해 페널티를 추가하는 훈련 없는 프레임워크입니다. 이는 멜라노마 사례를 일상적인 후속 조치로 잘못 분류하는 것과 같은 심각한 오류를 방지하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 시스템의 안전성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 필수적인 프레임워크로, 잠재적 피해를 최소화하면서 임상적 의사 결정 지원을 개선합니다.

items.title: Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates
items.body: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.
items.title_ko: 제어 변수를 활용한 시뮬레이션 보조 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시뮬레이션 보조 학습 방법으로 제어 변수(control variates)를 활용하여 시뮬레이터 부정확성으로 인한 성능 저하를 방지합니다. 시뮬레이션 데이터를 강화 학습 알고리즘에 직접 통합할 때 발생할 수 있는 문제점을 해결하고, 최적 정책에서 벗어나는 편향을 줄이는 보수적인 학습 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습에서 시뮬레이션 데이터를 더욱 효과적이고 안전하게 활용할 수 있는 방법을 제시하여, 실제 환경에서의 학습 비용을 줄이고 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
items.body: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
items.title_ko: TrialDesignBench: 임상 지식을 기반으로 한 Phase-I 임상 시험 설계를 위한 언어 모델 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: TrialDesignBench는 임상 시험 파이프라인에서 AI가 거의 발전하지 못한 Phase-I 임상 시험 설계에 대한 언어 모델의 능력을 평가하기 위한 벤치마크입니다. FDA의 Project Optimus와 같은 최신 규제 변화를 반영하여, LLM의 생의학 지식 및 통계적 추론 능력을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 분야에서 LLM이 임상 시험 설계와 같은 복잡한 의사 결정 과정에 미칠 수 있는 잠재력을 평가하고, AI 기반 의약품 개발을 가속화하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather
items.body: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.
items.title_ko: 화창한 날씨를 넘어: 악천후 시 도시 교통 예측에 대규모 언어 모델 사용
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 기존의 데이터 기반 모델이 악천후 상황에서 도시 교통 흐름 예측에 어려움을 겪는 문제를 해결하기 위해 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 활용합니다. LLM이 희귀한 기상 현상과 관련된 복잡한 비선형 변화를 포착하는 데 효과적임을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 지능형 교통 시스템 분야에서 AI 모델의 예측 능력을 악천후와 같은 복잡한 상황으로 확장하여, 교통 관리 및 안전성을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
items.body: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.
items.title_ko: 2차 선형 응답이 양자화 불일치를 얼마나 잘 예측하는가? 5개 언어 모델에 대한 사전 등록된 측정
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 2차 선형 응답(second-order linear response)이 양자화 불일치(quantization mismatch)를 얼마나 정확하게 예측하는지 5개 언어 모델(Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-30B-A3B)에 대해 사전 등록된 측정을 통해 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델 배포 시 양자화 전략의 효과를 예측하고 최적화하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, 모델 성능과 자원 효율성을 균형 있게 달성하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

items.title: Adapting Small Language Models to Romanized Nepali: Tokenizer Fertility, Reference Likelihood, and Generation Metrics
items.body: Romanized Nepali, Nepali written in Latin script, is common in digital communication but has no standard spelling and few resources, and it is unclear how reliably small open language models can be adapted to it. We adapt three 2-3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Gemma-2-2B, with QLoRA on 9,000 instruction examples produced by deterministic transliteration of Nepali instruction data. Each model is trained with one shared recipe and three seeds and evaluated on 1,000 held-out examples with reference-overlap metrics, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB), and an output audit, against zero-shot baselines under two prompts. Fine-tuning raises chrF++ from 10-14 to 29.0-30.6 and lowers BPB from 2.23-2.41 to 0.78-0.84; most zero-shot outputs (54-92%) are English-like. Likelihood and overlap disagree on how far apart the models are. Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB in every seed, 0.042 below Qwen2.5-3B (95% CI 0.039-0.046), yet the two cannot be separated on chrF++ (30.51 and 30.61) or BLEU, even with paired item-level tests. Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits Romanized Nepali words least (2.72 tokens per word), scores worst on every measure. Which model gains most over its zero-shot baseline depends on the zero-shot prompt. In a supplementary comparison with an identical tokenizer, Llama-3.1-8B lowers BPB by 0.053 (0.050-0.056) relative to Llama-3.2-3B, while chrF++ and BLEU rise by only 0.68 and 0.58 points. Lower fertility and higher reference likelihood therefore did not identify the model whose outputs were closest to the references.
items.title_ko: 로마자 네팔어에 소형 언어 모델 적용: 토크나이저 비옥도, 참조 가능성 및 생성 메트릭
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 로마자 네팔어(Latin 스크립트로 작성된 네팔어)에 소형 언어 모델을 적용하는 방법을 탐구합니다. Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, Gemma-2-2B 등 세 가지 모델을 미세 조정하고, 토크나이저 비옥도, 참조 가능성 및 생성 메트릭을 사용하여 그 효과를 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 자원 부족 언어에 대한 LLM의 적응 가능성을 보여주며, 다양한 언어 환경에서 AI 기술의 접근성과 활용성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Spike-to-Field Mechanisms of Turbulence-Like Dynamics in Spatial Spiking Neural Networks
items.body: Neural avalanches and turbulence-like brain dynamics are usually measured after neural activity has been coarse-grained into continuous fields, leaving open which spike-level mechanisms can generate these macroscopic observables. We build a spatial leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network and explicitly transform spikes into activity-density and Hilbert phase fields. A delayed, distance-dependent, passive-dendrite regime reproducibly generates turbulence-like field structure, including high-amplitude phase-defect tracks, structure-function scaling, and power-law-favored continuous-field avalanche tails. Controls show that firing rate, vortex count, and avalanche tail fits are individually insufficient: destroying delayed propagation, dendritic filtering, or spike timing suppresses key field signatures, while random-space nulls can retain many mathematical phase defects but show weaker spatial structure and synaptic-delay transfer. Biologically motivated gates further shape the regime: PV-like perisomatic inhibition clamps phase dynamics, SST-like dendritic inhibition and projection-specific inhibitory facilitation preserve long-lived tracks, and a rate-constrained projection-STP regime expresses a roughly 200-ms episode at 12.25 Hz (full-record mean) across 12 seeds. These results use SNNs as a mechanistic testbed for spike-derived brain turbulence observables and show why phase defects and avalanche-like statistics must be interpreted jointly with spatial scaling and spike-level propagation.
items.title_ko: 공간 스파이킹 신경망의 난류 유사 동역학의 스파이크-필드 메커니즘
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 공간 누설 적분 및 발화 스파이킹 신경망(spatial leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network)을 구축하여 신경 활동이 거시적인 필드로 거칠게 나타난 후 측정되는 신경 눈사태 및 난류 유사 뇌 동역학의 스파이크 수준 메커니즘을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 뇌의 복잡한 동역학을 신경망 모델로 설명하려는 시도로, 인공지능이 생물학적 지능을 모방하는 데 있어 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: Type-logical grammars and formal languages
items.body: We show that type-logical grammars with the standard rules for product, associativity, extraction and infixation have an NP-complete fixed recognition problem, adapting a construction for first-order linear logic from Pshenitsyn (2025), who already showed that grammars in first-order linear logic are closed under intersection and therefore not semilinear and not mildly context-sensitive. We strengthen these results and shown that grammars in first-order linear logic can simulate the quasi-linear grammars of Book \& Greibach (1970), the grammars recognised in non-deterministic linear time (NSPACE(n) or. NLIN). I argue that NLIN is an interesting class of formal languages as well, and a useful upper bound on the time complexity of formalisms used for natural language, just like LOGCFL is a useful upper bound on the space complexity. Taken together this means that first-order linear logic can be seen as the logic of non-deterministic linear-time string languages, graph languages and automata.
items.title_ko: 유형 논리 문법 및 형식 언어
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 곱셈, 연관성, 추출 및 중위법에 대한 표준 규칙을 가진 유형 논리 문법(type-logical grammars)이 NP-완전 고정 인식 문제(fixed recognition problem)를 가짐을 보여줍니다. 이는 1차 선형 논리의 문법이 교차에 대해 닫혀 있으므로 비선형적이거나 미미하게 문맥 의존적이지 않다는 기존 결과를 강화합니다.
items.why_ko: 자연어 처리 및 계산 언어학에서 형식 문법의 복잡성과 계산 효율성에 대한 이론적 이해를 심화시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Double Blind Evals: Resolving the Dual Confidentiality Dilemma in AI Safety Auditing
items.body: AI safety evaluations often involve sensitive prompts and proprietary models. Evaluators want to keep their evaluation prompts secret from model owners to prevent purposeful or incidental data leakage, ensuring longer usefulness of their benchmark. Model owners in turn wish to keep their proprietary model weights and inference code within their own secure infrastructure to protect their IP. We present a way forward for "double-blind evals", which provide cryptographic guarantees that an evaluator's prompts are not shared with the model owner, while simultaneously maintaining the confidentiality of the model weights and inference code. To accomplish this, we use secure enclaves that encrypt data in RAM at the hardware level. In a world-first pilot, we test this approach by evaluating a proprietary Google DeepMind model (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite) against a selection of the private AILuminate benchmark corpus, using an NVIDIA H100 secure enclave on Google Cloud Platform, and using OpenMined's PySyft to maintain data and model privacy. We believe this effort marks the first use of this technology to provide mutual secrecy for one organization's frontier-class proprietary model weights and another organization's closed benchmark.
items.body_ko: AI 안전 평가는 종종 민감한 프롬프트와 독점 모델을 포함합니다. 평가자는 의도적이거나 우발적인 데이터 유출을 방지하여 벤치마크의 유용성을 더 오래 유지하기 위해 평가 프롬프트를 모델 소유자에게 비밀로 유지하기를 원합니다. 모델 소유자는 IP 보호를 위해 독점 모델 가중치와 추론 코드를 자체 보안 인프라 내에 유지하기를 원합니다. 우리는 평가자의 프롬프트가 모델 소유자와 공유되지 않는다는 암호화 보장을 제공하면서 모델 가중치 및 추론 코드의 기밀성을 동시에 유지하는 "이중 맹검 평가"를 위한 방법을 제시합니다. 이를 달성하기 위해 하드웨어 수준에서 RAM의 데이터를 암호화하는 보안 엔클레이브를 사용합니다. 세계 최초의 파일럿에서 우리는 Google Cloud Platform의 NVIDIA H100 보안 엔클레이브와 OpenMined의 PySyft를 사용하여 데이터 및 모델 프라이버시를 유지하면서 독점 Google DeepMind 모델(Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite)을 비공개 AILuminate 벤치마크 코퍼스 중 일부에 대해 평가하여 이 접근 방식을 테스트합니다. 우리는 이 노력이 한 조직의 최첨단 독점 모델 가중치와 다른 조직의 비공개 벤치마크에 대한 상호 비밀을 제공하기 위해 이 기술을 사용한 첫 번째 사례라고 믿습니다.
items.title_ko: 이중 비공개 평가: AI 안전성 감사에서 이중 기밀성 딜레마 해결
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 AI 안전성 평가에서 민감한 프롬프트와 독점 모델로 인해 발생하는 '이중 기밀성 딜레마'를 해결하기 위한 '이중 비공개 평가(double-blind evals)' 방안을 제시합니다. 평가자와 모델 소유자 모두의 기밀성을 암호화 방식으로 보장하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 안전성 및 윤리 평가의 투명성과 신뢰성을 확보하면서도, 참여자들의 기밀 정보를 보호하는 중요한 방법론적 혁신을 제시합니다.

items.title: Unmasking Four Knapsack Problems in the Traveling Thief Benchmark
items.body: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.
items.title_ko: 여행 도둑 벤치마크에 숨겨진 네 가지 배낭 문제 폭로
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 여행 도둑 문제(Traveling Thief Problem, TTP) 벤치마크의 9,720개 인스턴스 중 4개가 실제 TTP 인스턴스가 아님을 밝힙니다. 이들 인스턴스는 임대료(renting rate)가 0.00으로 설정되어 있어, 투어 경로가 목표 함수에 영향을 미치지 않고 0-1 배낭 문제로 축소된다는 것을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 최적화 알고리즘 벤치마크의 유효성과 정확성에 대한 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, 연구자들이 사용하는 데이터셋의 품질을 다시 한번 검토하게 합니다.

items.title: Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.
items.title_ko: 설명 가능한 AI 내러티브의 공정성: LLM 생성 설명의 사회적 불균형 분해
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)이 SHAP와 같은 기술적 설명 가능한 AI(XAI) 아티팩트를 일반 사용자를 위한 설명 내러티브(XAINs)로 번역할 때 발생하는 공정성 문제를 탐구합니다. LLM이 사회적 편향을 재현할 수 있음을 지적하며 XAINs의 공정성 문제를 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 설명의 공정성과 신뢰성을 확보하는 데 중요한 연구로, AI 시스템이 사회적 편견을 재생산하지 않도록 하는 방안 모색에 기여합니다.

items.title: TRACE: Adaptive Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for Open-Ended Molecular Design
items.body: Optimizing molecules under small evaluation budgets requires deciding both where in chemical space to search and which candidate within that region to evaluate. We introduce Trust Region Adaptive Chemical Exploration (TRACE), a framework for open-ended molecular Bayesian optimization (BO), where candidates are generated on demand rather than selected from a fixed library. TRACE combines an objective-free graph-perturbation mechanism with a fixed, chemistry-aware Gaussian process (GP) surrogate using fragprints, a representation combining molecular fingerprints and fragment descriptors. Rather than learning the search geometry itself, TRACE makes the scale of chemical exploration explicit through a Tanimoto-similarity threshold controlling chemical extent and a cardinality budget controlling candidate-search breadth. A simple success/failure controller expands or contracts both quantities during optimization, while the GP and acquisition function select which admissible molecules to evaluate. Across six challenging molecular optimization benchmarks under matched 1,000-evaluation budgets, TRACE achieves the strongest overall sample efficiency as measured by the best molecule found as evaluations accumulate. Crossed ablations on two objectives further show that adaptive region control contributes beyond the proposal mechanism, while its benefit depends on the proposal distribution. We further apply TRACE to the stability of iron phthalocyanine (FePc), a non-precious molecular electrocatalyst whose degradation can involve loss of the Fe center. Using a first-principles density functional theory (DFT) workflow designed for accurate energy evaluation, TRACE increases the computed thermodynamic resistance to Fe dissolution from 0.42 to 2.59 eV over 80 designed evaluations.
items.title_ko: TRACE: 개방형 분자 설계를 위한 적응형 신뢰 영역 베이지안 최적화
items.summary_ko: TRACE(Trust Region Adaptive Chemical Exploration)는 소규모 평가 예산 하에서 분자를 최적화하기 위한 개방형 분자 베이지안 최적화(BO) 프레임워크입니다. 이 프레임워크는 목표 함수 없는 그래프 섭동 메커니즘과 화학적 인식을 갖춘 가우스 과정(GP) 대리 모델을 결합합니다.
items.why_ko: 화학 및 재료 과학 분야에서 AI 기반 분자 설계의 효율성을 크게 높여, 신약 개발 및 신소재 발견을 가속화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
items.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.
items.title_ko: AgentOPSD: 재귀적 신념 수정을 통한 턴-레벨 크레딧 할당
items.summary_ko: AgentOPSD는 긴 다단계 상호작용에서 성공에 기여하는 몇 안 되는 결정들을 분리하기 위해, 궤적 전체에 단일 이점(advantage)을 부여하는 강화 학습의 한계를 극복합니다. 비판기 없는(critic-free) 방식으로 재귀적으로 크레딧을 할당하여, 턴-레벨에서 더욱 세밀한 보상 신호를 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습, 특히 장기적인 멀티턴 상호작용에서 크레딧 할당 문제를 해결하여, AI 에이전트의 학습 효율성과 복잡한 작업 수행 능력을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: From Likelihood Convergence to Parameter Convergence in POMDPs
items.body: Likelihood-based methods are widely used to learn the parameters of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). While finite-sample guarantees for policy suboptimality exist for certain POMDP subclasses, analogous guarantees for parameter recovery remain less well understood. For any candidate POMDP parameter, we bound its parameter recovery error in terms of its likelihood gap to the ground truth, the structural conditioning of the observation and transition kernels, and the behavior policy used to collect data. The bound applies in both the undercomplete and overcomplete regimes, with the latter following naturally from the undercomplete analysis. Because the result applies to any sufficiently good candidate, it yields finite-sample guarantees for the maximum-likelihood estimator and any procedure producing a parameter with controlled likelihood gap. This is particularly useful for near-optimal learning in infinite-horizon POMDPs, where existing approaches largely rely on model-based planning with accurate transition and observation kernel estimates. The bound separates the contributions of the behavior policy and model, showing how data-collection choices, including action coverage, and their effects on mixing can accelerate parameter learning.
items.title_ko: POMDP에서 가능도 수렴에서 매개변수 수렴으로
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 부분 관측 가능한 마르코프 결정 과정(POMDPs)의 매개변수를 학습하는 데 널리 사용되는 가능도 기반 방법의 매개변수 복구 오류를 분석합니다. 어떤 후보 POMDP 매개변수에 대해서도, 지상 진실과의 가능도 간극, 관측 및 전환 커널의 구조적 조건, 행동의 역학 측면에서 매개변수 복구 오류를 제한합니다.
items.why_ko: POMDPs에서 모델 파라미터 학습의 이론적 기반을 강화하고, AI 시스템이 불확실한 환경에서 더 정확하고 신뢰할 수 있는 결정을 내리는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
items.body: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
items.title_ko: 유방 촬영술 비전-언어 모델의 교차 신호 일관성 평가
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 유방 촬영술 영상 분석을 위한 비전-언어 모델(VLM)의 교차 신호 일관성(cross-signal coherence)을 평가합니다. 정답, 신뢰도, 설명 간의 일관성을 유방 밀도 및 BI-RADS 분류를 위한 4개 VLM에 대해 두 가지 유방 촬영술 데이터셋을 사용하여 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 시스템, 특히 영상 진단 모델의 신뢰성과 투명성을 높이는 데 중요한 평가 프레임워크를 제공합니다.

items.title: LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off
items.body: Many tasks compose transformations by a known rule: chained rotations in robotics and navigation. Learned models relearn it, compounding error; classical estimators hardcode it and miss hardware deviations. We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N >= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols. The recipe matches classical fits where the data obey the law and loses where the imposed law is not the task's.
items.title_ko: LawKAN: 그룹-법칙 레이어를 통한 구성 -- 알려진 법칙을 부과할 때의 이점
items.summary_ko: LawKAN은 로봇 공학 및 내비게이션의 연쇄 회전과 같이 알려진 규칙에 따라 변환을 구성하는 작업에 대한 새로운 아키텍처입니다. 학습된 모델이 규칙을 다시 학습하여 오류를 축적하는 대신, 알려진 구조를 부과하고 나머지 부분만 학습하여 하드웨어 편차를 보정합니다.
items.why_ko: 기계 학습 모델이 물리 법칙이나 도메인 지식과 같은 알려진 규칙을 효과적으로 통합하여, 학습 효율성과 예측 정확도를 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
items.body: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.
items.title_ko: WanderBench: 세계 모델이 비디오에서 동적 세계를 탐험할 수 있는가?
items.summary_ko: WanderBench는 비디오 기반 세계 모델이 실제 기록된 동적 장면을 얼마나 충실하게 탐색할 수 있는지 평가하는 새로운 벤치마크입니다. 기존 벤치마크가 주로 지각 품질에 중점을 두었던 것과 달리, WanderBench는 생성된 롤아웃이 기록된 세계에 얼마나 충실하게 유지되는지를 직접적으로 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 기반 세계 모델의 핵심 역량인 동적 환경 탐색 및 세계 충실도 평가에 대한 표준 벤치마크를 제공하여, 에이전트 기반 AI 시스템의 현실 세계 적용 가능성을 높입니다.

items.title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
items.body: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

items.title: A Strict Upper Bound for Three-Point Weighted Selection in Planar Vector-Valued Regression
items.body: We prove $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,3)<11/6$ for minimum-Frobenius-norm least-squares regression with two input and two output coordinates, improving the upper bound $15/8$. More precisely, a universal $\varepsilon_0>0$ satisfies $\mathcal T_3\le(5/6-\varepsilon_0)E$ for every finite residual frame. The proof combines an exact scalar certificate, rigidity of equality in planar selection, and a compactness argument that controls disappearing weights. Together with the known lower bound, this gives $13/8\le F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,3)<11/6$. No numerical value of $\varepsilon_0$ is claimed.
items.title_ko: 평면 벡터 값 회귀에서 3점 가중치 선택에 대한 엄격한 상한
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 두 입력 및 두 출력 좌표를 갖는 최소 프로베니우스-노름 최소 제곱 회귀(minimum-Frobenius-norm least-squares regression)에서 $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,3)<11/6$라는 엄격한 상한을 증명합니다. 이는 특정 기하학적 조건 하에서 가중치 선택 문제의 정확한 한계를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 회귀 분석 및 최적화 분야에서 가중치 선택 문제에 대한 이론적 이해를 심화시키고, 기계 학습 알고리즘의 성능 분석에 기여합니다.

items.title: Learning inexact alternating minimization for convex problems with quadratic coupling
items.body: Alternating minimization is a standard tool for optimization problems with two coupled variable blocks. Its cost is dominated by the inner subproblem solvers, which rarely have a closed-form solution. In this paper, we propose to learn an inexact alternating scheme in which neural networks approximate the subproblem solution at each iteration. For convex problems with quadratic couplings between the variable blocks that satisfy a quadratic growth condition, we derive a worst-case bound on the optimality gap that exposes the per-iteration error that each network is trained to minimize in a greedy fashion. Combining the bound with a PAC-Bayes argument, we obtain a fixed-horizon, high-probability bound on the expected optimality gap over the distribution of problem instances. We apply the learned scheme to robust matrix completion and low-dose CT reconstruction with dictionary regularization where we achieve a 5x-13x speedup over the inexact first-order baseline at matched accuracy. A brief end-to-end fine-tuning stage extends this up to 30x and outperforms other learned schemes. The code is available at https://github.com/paulhausner/learned-alternating-minimization.
items.title_ko: 2차 결합을 가진 볼록 문제에 대한 부정확한 교대 최소화 학습
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 두 개의 결합된 변수 블록을 갖는 볼록 문제에 대한 교대 최소화(alternating minimization)의 부정확한 학습 체계를 제안합니다. 각 반복에서 신경망이 부분 문제의 솔루션을 근사하여, 이너 서브문제 솔버에 의해 지배되는 비용을 줄이는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 최적화 문제 해결에 딥러닝을 통합하는 새로운 방법을 제시하여, 복잡한 볼록 문제의 계산 효율성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels
items.body: Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.
items.title_ko: K-prop: 시계열 커널 역전파를 통한 딥 온라인 학습
items.summary_ko: K-prop은 누출 신경망을 위한 새로운 온라인 학습 방식으로, 실시간 순환 학습(RTRL)의 계산 및 메모리 비용을 크게 줄입니다. 이 방식은 기울기의 복잡한 시계열 종속성 때문에 부족했던 효율적이고 효과적인 온라인 훈련 방법을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 시계열 데이터 처리 및 딥러닝 모델의 온라인 학습 효율을 개선하여, 자율 시스템이나 실시간 데이터 분석 등 실제 애플리케이션에 유용할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Perceived Agency During Agent-Avatar Control Transitions in Virtual Reality
items.body:
Prior beliefs about whether a virtual human (VH) is controlled by a human or a computer can shape how users interpret and respond to its behaviour. As emerging hybrid VH systems allow control to transfer between human operators and computer programs during an ongoing interaction, it remains unclear whether perceived agency updates with the actual controller or continues to reflect users' prior beliefs and first impressions. We investigated this question in a within-subject VR study with 24 participants across four conditions: always computer-controlled, computer-to-human, human-to-computer, and always human-controlled. We designed an interaction task in which participants acted as interviewers, asking the VHs a fixed set of questions. Before each interaction, participants were informed whether the VH was human- or computer-controlled, matching the actual controller at the beginning, but were unaware of possible control transitions.
We found that perceived agency was strongly influenced by the controller presented at the beginning of the interaction, with no evidence of updating following the control transitions. Social evaluations including likeability and co-presence were generally higher in conditions where human control occurred later and covered a greater proportion of the interaction. The results suggest that prior beliefs and first impressions continued to shape perceived agency, whereas social evaluations were more sensitive to the VH's actual behaviour over the interaction.
items.title_ko: VR 환경에서 에이전트-아바타 제어 전환 시 인지되는 주체성
items.summary_ko: 가상 인간(VH)이 인간에 의해 제어되는지 컴퓨터에 의해 제어되는지에 대한 사전 믿음이 사용자가 행동을 해석하는 방식에 영향을 미칩니다. 이 연구는 하이브리드 VH 시스템에서 제어권이 전환될 때 사용자의 인지된 주체성이 실제 제어자에 따라 업데이트되는지, 아니면 초기 믿음을 계속 반영하는지를 VR 실험을 통해 조사했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트와 사용자 간의 상호작용 디자인에 중요한 통찰을 제공하여, 가상 현실, 게임, 교육 등 다양한 분야에서 AI 에이전트의 몰입도와 신뢰성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: WaveGen: Truly End-to-End Waveform Generation via Internal Spectral Trajectory Learning
items.body: This work proposes WaveGen, a fully end-to-end diffusion-based text-to-waveform framework based on Spectral Forcing, which jointly learns an internal spectral trajectory and the target waveform trajectory within a single model, enabling direct end-to-end text-to-waveform generation. Unlike recent TTS pipelines, WaveGen does not rely on separately trained or externally decoded intermediate representations, such as neural audio codecs, Mel-spectrogram vocoders, or VAE-based latent models. In addition, WaveGen performs internal text-speech alignment within a single model, eliminating the need for external alignment modules such as duration predictors. To preserve a truly end-to-end formulation, our framework further avoids dependence on self-supervised representations, such as BERT-based text embeddings and Wav2Vec 2.0-based semantic representations, as well as semantic distillation methods for training optimization. To achieve this, we carefully design Spectral Forcing, a model architecture with disentangled diffusion heads, and a training objective based on a multi-scale spectral $v$-loss. We further validate the scalability of end-to-end TTS models by scaling the model size from 0.1B to 0.6B parameters. Using a single architecture, open-source data, and one-stage training, without external modules such as duration predictor or REPA, WaveGen demonstrates fully end-to-end waveform generation achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Emilia training dataset. In particular, WaveGen achieves a WER of 1.47 and a SIM of 0.75 on the Seed-en benchmark. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/sh-lee-prml/WaveGen
items.body_ko: 본 연구는 Spectral Forcing을 기반으로 하는 완전한 End-to-End Diffusion 기반 텍스트-파형 프레임워크인 WaveGen을 제안합니다. 이는 단일 모델 내에서 내부 스펙트럼 궤적과 대상 파형 궤적을 동시에 학습하여 직접적인 End-to-End 텍스트-파형 생성을 가능하게 합니다. 최근 TTS 파이프라인과 달리 WaveGen은 별도로 훈련되거나 외부에서 디코딩된 중간 표현(예: 신경 오디오 코덱, Mel-spectrogram 보코더 또는 VAE 기반 잠재 모델)에 의존하지 않습니다. 또한 WaveGen은 단일 모델 내에서 내부 텍스트-음성 정렬을 수행하여 지속 시간 예측기와 같은 외부 정렬 모듈의 필요성을 없앱니다. 진정한 End-to-End 공식을 유지하기 위해, 우리 프레임워크는 BERT 기반 텍스트 임베딩 및 Wav2Vec 2.0 기반 의미론적 표현과 같은 자체 지도 표현뿐만 아니라 훈련 최적화를 위한 의미론적 증류 방법에도 의존하지 않습니다. 이를 위해 우리는 분리된 Diffusion 헤드와 다중 스케일 스펙트럼 v-loss를 기반으로 하는 훈련 목표를 가진 Spectral Forcing 모델 아키텍처를 신중하게 설계합니다. 우리는 모델 크기를 0.1B에서 0.6B 매개변수로 확장하여 End-to-End TTS 모델의 확장성을 추가로 검증합니다. 단일 아키텍처, 오픈 소스 데이터 및 단일 단계 훈련을 사용하여 지속 시간 예측기 또는 REPA와 같은 외부 모듈 없이 WaveGen은 Emilia 훈련 데이터셋에서 최첨단 성능을 달성하는 완전한 End-to-End 파형 생성을 시연합니다. 특히 WaveGen은 Seed-en 벤치마크에서 1.47의 WER과 0.75의 SIM을 달성합니다. 소스 코드 및 체크포인트는 https://github.com/sh-lee-prml/WaveGen에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
items.title_ko: WaveGen: 내부 스펙트럼 궤적 학습을 통한 완전한 종단 간 파형 생성
items.summary_ko: WaveGen은 Spectral Forcing 기반의 완전한 종단 간 확산 모델로, 텍스트에서 파형을 직접 생성합니다. 기존 TTS 파이프라인과 달리 별도로 훈련된 중간 표현(오디오 코덱, 멜 스펙트로그램 보코더 등)에 의존하지 않고 내부 스펙트럼 궤적과 목표 파형 궤적을 단일 모델 내에서 공동으로 학습합니다.
items.why_ko: 음성 합성 파이프라인을 단순화하고 효율성을 높여, 더 자연스럽고 고품질의 음성 생성을 가능하게 할 뿐만 아니라 실시간 TTS 애플리케이션의 개발을 가속화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models
items.body: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).
items.title_ko: System 1 모델의 신뢰도 및 결정: Jev-스타일 결정 모델의 설명 가능성 및 교란 감사
items.summary_ko: "System 1" 결정 모델은 자동회귀 텍스트 생성을 단일 순방향 패스로 대체하여 선언된 스키마에 대한 유형화된 확률 분포를 반환합니다. 이 연구는 이러한 모델의 통계적 보정 및 사후 설명 가능성을 평가하기 위한 공개적이고 결정론적인 감사 벤치마크를 소개하고, 레이블 보존 교란 하에서의 보정을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 신속하고 결정적인 AI 의사결정 모델의 신뢰성과 투명성을 검증하는 방법을 제공하여, AI 시스템의 책임감 있는 개발과 배포에 기여합니다.

items.title: UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
items.body: Accurate prediction of electronic Hamiltonians would enable broad property inference while avoiding the high computational cost of Density Functional Theory (DFT). However, progress toward general-purpose materials foundation models is limited by a data bottleneck: existing Hamiltonian datasets are typically small, lack structural diversity, and often omit essential relativistic physics such as spin--orbit coupling (SOC). We therefore construct UniHam, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset and benchmark suite comprising 100,000+ DFT-computed complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians with full SOC, covering 72 elements and a wide range of crystal geometries and symmetries (spanning diverse lattice types and space-group families). Building on UniHam, we benchmark two representative state-of-the-art models under a standardized protocol and introduce complementary evaluation metrics that jointly assess three dimensions: (i) Hamiltonian reconstruction accuracy, (ii) out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization across composition/symmetry shifts, and (iii) the ability to support downstream property prediction from the predicted Hamiltonians. Experiments on UniHam demonstrate that the proposed benchmark and metrics effectively differentiate model capabilities, revealing intrinsic SOC- and element-dependent failure modes, large variations in compositional OOD robustness, and the necessity of spectral-level evaluation to assess whether Hamiltonian predictions reliably support downstream electronic-structure properties. Overall, UniHam provides a reproducible, SOC-complete benchmark that can sharpen model comparisons and accelerate the development of next-generation foundation models for quantum materials.
items.title_ko: UniHam: 재료 해밀턴 학습을 위한 대규모 SOC-완전 데이터셋 및 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 전자 해밀턴의 정확한 예측은 밀도 범함수 이론(DFT)의 높은 계산 비용 없이 광범위한 물성 추론을 가능하게 합니다. 기존 해밀턴 데이터셋의 한계를 극복하기 위해, 이 연구는 스핀-궤도 결합(SOC)과 같은 필수 상대론적 물리학을 포함하는 대규모 해밀턴 데이터셋 및 벤치마크인 UniHam을 구축했습니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 과학 분야에서 일반 목적의 파운데이션 모델 개발을 가속화하여, 새로운 재료 발견 및 물성 예측의 정확도와 효율성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: MARS: Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams for Video Forgery Detection
items.body: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate combines their predictions. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC of 91.43\%, outperforming seven compared detectors. When trained on facial manipulations alone, MARS achieves 93.99\% AUROC on GenVideo and 75.50\% on DF26, demonstrating transfer to generated videos without generated-video training data. MARS also provides signed patch and frame contributions, whose faithfulness we evaluate through controlled spatial and temporal removal against random controls. MARS is publicly available for research: Project page: https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mars/ Github: https://github.com/VectorInstitute/mars
items.title_ko: MARS: 비디오 위변조 탐지를 위한 다중 스케일 외형-잔차 스트림
items.summary_ko: MARS는 다중 스케일 특징 차이를 조정된 외형 표현과 결합하여 비디오 위변조 탐지 성능을 개선하는 방법을 연구합니다. 얼굴 조작과 완전히 생성된 비디오 전반에 걸쳐 딥페이크 탐지를 일반화하는 것이 도전적이며, 위변조 흔적은 조작 방법과 장면 내용에 따라 다양하게 나타납니다.
items.why_ko: 딥페이크 및 AI 생성 비디오의 탐지 정확도를 높여, 허위 정보 확산을 방지하고 미디어의 신뢰성을 유지하는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation
items.body: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.
items.title_ko: 장문 동시 음성 번역에서 텍스트 그룹화가 완료 시간 비교에 미치는 영향
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 음성 합성을 위해 번역 업데이트를 그룹화하는 방식이 두 번역기 간의 완료 시간 차이에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 비교합니다. StreamAtt와 고정 오디오 히스토리 기준선 모델을 사용하여 10개의 영어-독일어 강연에서 번역 업데이트 그룹화 방식에 따른 완료 시간 변화를 측정했습니다.
items.why_ko: 동시 음성 번역 시스템의 성능 평가와 사용자 경험에 영향을 미치는 요소를 밝혀내, 실시간 번역 기술의 최적화에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
items.body: Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.
items.title_ko: 재료 발견을 위한 베이지안 최적화에 바로 적용 가능한 테이블 파운데이션 모델
items.summary_ko: 베이지안 최적화는 재료 과학의 능동 학습 루프에서 널리 사용되지만, 가우시안 프로세스는 태스크 의존적인 커널 선택과 복잡한 관계 모델링 능력 부족의 한계가 있습니다. 이 연구는 TabPFN과 TabICL 두 가지 테이블 파운데이션 모델(TFM)을 아웃 오브 더 박스(out-of-the-box) 서브로게이트 모델로 평가하여 기존 방식의 한계를 극복할 수 있음을 보입니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 발견 과정에서 모델링 효율성과 예측 정확도를 높여, 새로운 재료를 더 빠르고 효율적으로 탐색할 수 있는 가능성을 제시합니다.

items.title: Detecting AI-Authored Text in Authentic Student Writing: Evidence from PISA 2025
items.body: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.
items.title_ko: 실제 학생 작문에서 AI 생성 텍스트 탐지: PISA 2025 증거
items.summary_ko: AI 텍스트 탐지기는 연구자가 설계한 프롬프트로 생성된 텍스트와 인간이 작성한 텍스트를 대조하는 평가에서 거의 완벽한 점수를 달성합니다. 하지만 실제 학생 작문 환경에서는 AI 사용이 자발적이고 부분적인 경우가 많습니다. 이 연구는 PISA 2025 FLA 데이터셋을 사용하여 독일 15세 학생들이 gpt-4o-mini 기반 챗봇 접근 여부에 따라 작성한 영어 논증 에세이에서 AI 사용을 추적하고 탐지하는 방법을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 교육 환경에서 AI 글쓰기 도구의 사용 증가에 따라, AI 생성 텍스트를 효과적으로 탐지하고 학생들의 학습 및 평가 과정에 미치는 영향을 이해하는 데 필수적인 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions
items.body: Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.
items.title_ko: AuDiR: 규칙 및 인지 개입을 통한 오디오 추론 진단
items.summary_ko: AuDiR(Audio Diagnostic Reasoning)은 음향 인지, 규칙 지식, 규칙 적용의 실패를 구분하기 위해 통제된 입력 개입을 통해 진단합니다. 각 항목은 오디오 클립, 객관식 질문, 작업 일반 규칙, 답변에 필요한 음향 관찰에 대한 텍스트 설명을 포함하며, 점진적으로 규칙과 관찰을 제공하는 3가지 조건과 오디오를 제거한 1가지 조건으로 구성됩니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 오디오 정보를 어떻게 추론하고 처리하는지 깊이 있게 이해하여, 음성 인식, 사운드 분류 등 오디오 기반 AI 시스템의 정확성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Learning to Select Sparse Linear Solvers with Convolutional Neural Networks
items.body: We investigate convolutional-neural-network (CNN) based automatic solver selection for sparse linear systems, a problem of practical importance where solver performance varies dramatically with matrix sparsity structure. A CNN is trained to regress log timing ratios between candidate solvers using spy plot images of matrix nonzero structure as input, achieving strong prediction accuracy on both held-out SuiteSparse matrices and real-world matrices from high-performance simulation codes.
items.title_ko: 합성곱 신경망을 이용한 희소 선형 솔버 선택 학습
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 희소 선형 시스템을 위한 합성곱 신경망(CNN) 기반 자동 솔버 선택 문제를 탐구합니다. CNN은 입력으로 행렬의 0이 아닌 구조의 스파이 플롯 이미지를 사용하여 후보 솔버 간의 로그 타이밍 비율을 회귀하도록 훈련되며, 높은 예측 정확도를 달성합니다.
items.why_ko: 과학적 시뮬레이션 및 엔지니어링 문제에서 희소 선형 시스템을 효율적으로 해결하는 데 기여하여 계산 효율성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: Prediction with Foundation Models under Deployment Budgets
items.body: Foundation models can supply predictions for a downstream task that draw on knowledge from extensive pretraining, but they differ in task-specific accuracy and query cost. We develop a framework that improves prediction for the task under a budget on the average query cost per input, using training data to learn which models to query and how to combine their outputs with features available without querying. The first method queries the same models for every input; the second lets them vary across inputs and uses Q-learning to decide which model to query next and when to stop. For the first method, we show that several individually inaccurate outputs can jointly outperform the best single one. It attains the minimax rate when the regression function depends on the outputs only through models within the budget. Otherwise, any method within the budget can be forced to a slower rate, which the first method attains. For the second method, we show when varying the queried models across inputs strictly improves on querying the same models for every input, and bound its prediction risk and average cost in finite samples. In simulations and a multimodal laptop price application, both methods outperform existing methods.
items.title_ko: 배포 예산 제약 하의 파운데이션 모델 예측
items.summary_ko: 파운데이션 모델은 사전 훈련된 광범위한 지식을 활용하여 예측을 제공하지만, 작업별 정확도와 쿼리 비용이 다릅니다. 이 프레임워크는 평균 쿼리 비용에 대한 예산 제약 하에서 작업 예측을 개선하며, 어떤 모델에 쿼리할지, 쿼리 없이 사용 가능한 특성과 모델 출력을 결합하는 방법을 학습하는 훈련 데이터를 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 제한된 자원 환경에서 파운데이션 모델의 효율적인 활용 전략을 제시하여, 실제 배포 시 비용-성능 트레이드오프를 최적화하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

items.title: Phrase-Level Speculative Decoding on a Frozen Target
items.body:
Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary.
We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking.
On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.
items.body_ko:
추측성 디코더는 포워드 패스당 더 많은 대상 토큰을 저장하여 처리량을 높이고, Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash 및 DSpark는 모두 동일한 방식으로 작동합니다: 검증을 통과하는 더 많은 후보. 이들 모두 대상의 고유한 어휘로 초안을 작성하므로 후보 트리의 한 노드는 하나의 대상 토큰이며, 토크나이저는 이 단위를 상수로 보이게 합니다. 하지만 그렇지 않습니다. BPE의 사전 토크나이저는 병합이 학습되기 전에 공백을 기준으로 분할하므로, 여러 단어로 된 문자열은 절대 단일 토큰이 될 수 없습니다. Qwen3-4B에서 "United States of America"는 4개의 토큰이며 인접한 두 쌍 중 어떤 것도 하나의 항목으로 존재하지 않으므로, 구문은 대상의 어휘로 초안을 작성하는 어떤 방법으로도 도달할 수 없습니다.
우리는 단위를 변경합니다. 작은 MLP 헤드가 고정된 대상의 Hidden State를 읽고 1~3개의 단어로 된 구문을 별도의 초안 어휘의 한 항목으로 예측합니다. 탐욕적인 최장 일치 확장은 이를 대상의 고유 토큰으로 다시 매핑하고, N개의 후보가 접두사 트리 마스크 뒤에서 한 번의 포워드 패스로 검증되므로 변경 사항은 트리 깊이 및 너비와 직교합니다. 대상 및 해당 토크나이저는 고정된 상태를 유지하며 후보는 대상의 고유한 Argmax와 일치하는 동안에만 수락되므로, 제공되는 출력은 부동 소수점 동점 해제까지 탐욕적인 디코딩과 동일합니다.
배치 1에서 하나의 A5000에서 HuggingFace generate()에 대해 21.94M 헤드(Qwen3-4B의 0.545%)는 GSM8K에서 2.391배, MATH-500에서 2.444배, MT-Bench에서 1.544배에 도달합니다. 헤드의 출력 레이어는 항목당 257개 매개변수의 한 행이므로 초안 어휘 크기가 매개변수 예산입니다. 8,000개 항목 헤드는 3.434M 매개변수로, 대상의 0.0854%이며 EAGLE-3의 드래프터보다 64배 작고, 더 큰 헤드의 GSM8K 토큰당 92.3%를 유지합니다. 동일한 프롬프트 및 기준선에서 EAGLE-3을 실행했을 때, 우리의 21.94M 헤드는 두 수학 세트 모두에서 tree-16보다 앞서며, 모든 세트에서 tree-60보다 뒤쳐집니다.
items.title_ko: 고정된 대상에 대한 구문 단위 투기적 디코딩
items.summary_ko: 투기적 디코딩은 한 번의 순방향 패스로 더 많은 타겟 토큰을 확보하여 처리량을 높입니다. 이 연구는 기존의 토큰 단위 드래프팅 방식에서 벗어나, BPE 토크나이저의 전처리 단계에서 발생하는 구문 구조를 활용하여 '구문 단위(phrase-level)' 투기적 디코딩의 가능성을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 추론 속도를 획기적으로 향상시킬 수 있는 새로운 디코딩 기법을 제시하여, 대규모 모델의 실용성과 접근성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Causal discovery from Bayesian symbolic regression
items.body: Causal discovery from observational data is central to scientific reasoning, yet established constraint-based and score-based methods often recover only a Markov equivalence class and provide no signal in bivariate or strongly autocorrelated regimes typical in some areas of science. Here, we recast causal discovery as a Bayesian symbolic regression problem. Given a set of candidate parents for each target variable, the Bayesian symbolic regression samples closed-form expressions from a posterior over symbolic models. The fraction of sampled expressions in which each candidate variable appears defines a posterior inclusion probability that we use as the causal score. This replaces pointwise model selection by an ensemble of plausible mechanisms. We evaluate the method on coupled nonlinear bivariate dynamics, on the CauseMe benchmark suite spanning linear, chaotic, nonlinear, higher-dimensional and high-noise settings, and on a four-variable biogeoscience structural causal model under Gaussian, heavy-tailed and mixed-noise regimes. Our approach is competitive with, and often outperforms, specialized causal discovery algorithms. Additionally, the method returns closed-form mechanisms leading to explicit causality and interpretability.
items.title_ko: 베이지안 심볼릭 회귀를 통한 인과 관계 발견
items.summary_ko: 관측 데이터에서 인과 관계를 발견하는 것은 과학적 추론의 핵심이지만, 기존의 제약 기반 및 점수 기반 방법은 마르코프 동치 클래스만 복구하고 일부 과학 분야에서 흔히 볼 수 있는 이변량 또는 강한 자기상관 체제에서는 신호를 제공하지 않습니다. 이 연구는 인과 관계 발견을 베이지안 심볼릭 회귀 문제로 재구성합니다.
items.why_ko: 더 복잡하고 실제적인 데이터에서 인과 관계를 효과적으로 발견할 수 있는 새로운 방법론을 제시하여, 과학 연구 및 의사결정 분야에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Pricing Symbolic Rules by What GNNs Leave Unlearned
items.body: Symbolic knowledge (motif counts, ring counts, label constraints) is routinely added to graph neural networks (GNNs) and justified by their limited expressivity. We replace this yardstick with an exact one. The largest log-loss reduction a rule $S$ can give a model family is $I(Y;S\midσ)$ given what the family computes; every realised gain splits exactly into this term plus repaid neural debt; and for a trained network with representation $T$ the value is $I(Y;S\mid T)$, the label information training failed to extract. Rule design thus becomes rule discovery: we score candidates on the network's out-of-fold residual against calibrated permutation nulls with family-wise error control. On ZINC, discovery recovers the hidden ring term $\max(0,\ell_{\max}-6)$ of the target in three independent runs ($p_{\mathrm{adj}}=0.001$) and beats expert cycle counts; frozen and applied to five unseen datasets it is never significantly worse than the plain network or the expert rule, and on BBBP it significantly beats both.
items.title_ko: GNN이 학습하지 못한 심볼릭 규칙의 가치 평가
items.summary_ko: 심볼릭 지식(모티프 개수, 링 개수, 레이블 제약)은 그래프 신경망(GNN)에 정기적으로 추가되며, GNN의 제한된 표현력 때문에 정당화됩니다. 이 연구는 이러한 기준을 정확한 척도로 대체합니다. 규칙 S가 모델 패밀리에 줄 수 있는 가장 큰 로그 손실 감소는 $I(Y;S\midσ)$이며, 훈련된 네트워크의 표현 T에 대한 값은 $I(Y;S\mid T)$입니다.
items.why_ko: GNN과 심볼릭 지식의 결합을 최적화하고, 모델의 설명 가능성을 높이는 데 기여하여, 그래프 기반 AI 시스템의 성능과 해석을 개선할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Patching Up Circuit Learning via Parameter Sharing
items.body: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) have emerged as generative models guaranteeing tractable probabilistic inference. However, tractability comes at the price of larger model sizes than in other generative models. As such, to scale PCs to high-dimensional data such as images, previous work has devised several parameter sharing techniques as well as fast evaluation protocols that consider learning PCs on independent image patches. In this work, we revisit this practice to highlight a surprising learnability issue: models that assume independence counterintuitively can yield better likelihoods than models that do not. To break this apparent bottleneck and to scale PCs further, we introduce a recursive parameter sharing construction (RePA) that fosters efficiency without assuming independence. We show empirically that RePA can greatly reduce time and memory consumption while yielding competitive likelihoods. Inspired by these results, we further generalize the approach to data modalities that do not inherently exhibit patch-structure (NoPA), such as tabular data, showing similar efficiency improvements, with marginal changes in likelihoods and sample quality on seven tabular datasets. Code available at https://github.com/april-tools/RePA.
items.title_ko: 파라미터 공유를 통한 회로 학습의 개선
items.summary_ko: 확률론적 회로(PCs)는 추론이 다루기 쉬운 생성 모델로 부상했지만, 다른 생성 모델에 비해 모델 크기가 크다는 단점이 있습니다. 이 연구는 이 문제를 해결하기 위해 이미지 패치에 대한 PC 학습을 고려하는 이전 연구의 파라미터 공유 기술과 빠른 평가 프로토콜을 재검토하여 놀라운 학습 능력을 강조합니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 데이터에 대한 확률론적 회로의 확장성을 개선하고, 더 효율적인 생성 모델 학습 방법을 제시하여, 이미지 생성 및 분석 분야에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: To SIMD or Not to SIMD: Comparing RVV vs. CGRA SoCs for Non-Linear Functions in AI
items.body: Non-linear functions are an important class of operations in modern large language models. However, chip vendors building for AI have so far relied on traditional vector or scalar processing units for non-linear functions. The performance of these units has not kept pace with matrix multiplication units (MMUs), which can be found in both high-performance and edge-computing devices from almost every vendor. Reconfigurable units such as FPGAs and CGRAs have been proposed in the literature, but have not been systematically compared with traditional units backed by MMUs. In this paper, we build two SoCs: one using an RVV vector processor and the other using a latency-insensitive (\emph{elastic}) CGRA, both coupled with an MMU and driven by a single-core CPU. We then propose mappings for common feed-forward networks on our SoCs and find that the CGRA reaches a maximum speedup in clock cycles of 7.12x over RVV on the activation stage of simple point-wise non-linear functions like SiLU, whereas the RVV reaches a maximum speedup of \textbf{9.8x} over the CGRA on complex non-linear functions such as $\mathrm{softmax}$. Over the enclosing feed-forward block the corresponding maxima are 3.16x and 4.24x.
items.title_ko: SIMD 대 CGRA SoC: AI 비선형 함수를 위한 비교
items.summary_ko: 비선형 함수는 최신 대규모 언어 모델에서 중요한 연산이지만, AI 칩 공급업체들은 아직 전통적인 벡터 또는 스칼라 처리 장치에 의존하고 있습니다. 이 장치들의 성능은 매트릭스 곱셈 장치의 발전 속도를 따라가지 못하고 있습니다. 이 연구는 RISC-V 벡터(RVV)와 CGRA(Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Array) SoC(System-on-Chip)를 비선형 함수 처리 관점에서 비교 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 가속기 설계 및 최적화에 중요한 통찰을 제공하여, LLM과 같은 복잡한 AI 모델의 연산 효율성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Can Frontier Auto Researchers Reconstruct Human Research Decisions in AI?
items.body: Scientific research has long been driven by substantial human effort, from reviewing prior work and identifying research gaps to designing specific solutions. Recent advances in harness-based agent systems have given rise to increasingly capable Auto Researchers, which can autonomously carry out these tasks and, increasingly, entire end-to-end research workflows. Yet despite their rapidly growing capabilities, how closely the research decisions and outputs produced by auto researchers align with those of human experts remains underexplored. We investigate this gap through the lens of research reconstruction and study: Given comparable research context, how similar are the research decisions and outputs produced by Auto Researchers to those of human researchers in AI research? To answer this question, we introduce AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity (AutoHRS), a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing how faithfully auto researchers reconstruct human research artifacts across different stages of the scientific workflow. Using 152 ICLR oral papers as our corpus, we generate 456 research trajectories spanning different stages of the research process. Applying AutoHRS to these trajectories, we find that current Auto Researchers frequently fail to recover key research decisions and their resulting artifacts across multiple stages of the research process.
items.title_ko: 선도적 자동 연구 에이전트가 AI 분야의 인간 연구 결정을 재구성할 수 있을까?
items.summary_ko: 과학 연구는 오랫동안 인간의 상당한 노력에 의해 주도되었지만, 최근 에이전트 시스템의 발전으로 자동 연구 에이전트가 이러한 작업을 자율적으로 수행하고 있습니다. 이 연구는 자동 연구 에이전트가 생성하는 연구 결정 및 결과가 인간 연구자들의 결정과 얼마나 밀접하게 일치하는지 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 자동 연구 시스템의 잠재력과 한계를 이해하는 데 도움을 주어, 미래 과학 연구 방법론의 발전 방향을 제시할 수 있습니다.

items.title: UCB-min: Combining Bandits Under Variance Heterogeneity (Extended Version)
items.body: Multi-armed bandits are a natural framework for many real-world sequential decision problems, from recommender systems and clinical trials to educational test recommendation and online advertising. The performance of these algorithms depends on how they explore different arms, and exploration strategies range from variance-independent (e.g., UCB1) to variance-aware (e.g., UCB-V). In practice the reward variance of each arm is rarely known and varies widely across arms, and the reward support is often underspecified. In these cases no single rule is uniformly best: variance-independent methods are robust but loose when variances are small, while variance-aware methods are tight only when their variance estimates and the assumed support bound are reliable. Such heterogeneous, unknown variances arise in many settings, for instance when multiple objectives are scalarized into a single reward. We propose UCB-min, a per-arm adaptive meta-algorithm that selects, for each arm, the tighter of a variance-independent and a variance-aware exploration bonus, without prior knowledge of the variance regime and without reward normalization. We prove that, with UCB-V as variance-aware base, its regret is bounded by the sum of the two base bounds at the standard exploration constant, and by their per-arm minimum, up to a constant, for a larger one. We validate it on synthetic data, an educational tutoring task, and two group-recommendation benchmarks (MovieLens, Steam), showing that UCB-min consistently tracks the best base algorithm across diverse variance regimes and datasets.
items.title_ko: UCB-min: 분산 이질성 하에서 밴딧 알고리즘 결합 (확장 버전)
items.summary_ko: 다중 암 밴딧은 추천 시스템, 임상 시험, 교육 테스트 추천 등 실제 순차적 의사결정 문제에 유용한 프레임워크입니다. 이 연구는 각 암의 보상 분산이 알려지지 않고 크게 다르며 보상 지지체가 유한하지 않을 때, 분산 이질성 하에서 밴딧 알고리즘을 결합하는 새로운 UCB-min 알고리즘을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 다양한 실제 애플리케이션에서 밴딧 알고리즘의 탐색 전략을 개선하여, 의사결정의 효율성과 성능을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
items.body: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.
items.title_ko: dNaViT: 이산 코드는 범용 시각 표현이다
items.summary_ko: dNaViT은 네이티브 해상도 비전 트랜스포머로, 이산 코드를 범용 시각 표현으로 활용하여 시각 모델과 언어 모델을 통합 프레임워크로 수렴시킵니다. 이 연구는 유한한 이산 어휘가 시각 세계의 풍부함을 얼마나 잘 표현할 수 있는지 탐구하며, 이를 통해 공유된 방법론과 인프라를 촉진합니다.
items.why_ko: 시각 및 언어 모델 간의 통합 프레임워크를 제시하여, 멀티모달 AI 모델의 개발을 가속화하고 AI의 범용성을 확장하는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Physics-informed neural networks in the small-data regime: A controlled comparison with classical PDE surrogates
items.body: Neural surrogates for engineering models are often trained on large collections of simulated solutions. We investigate whether physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can achieve accurate predictions from scarce labelled observations by incorporating governing equations and prescribed initial and boundary conditions. We introduce hierarchical loss weighting (H-PINN) and its gradient-direction-aware extension (HO-PINN), which adjust the emphasis on physical constraints according to higher-priority losses. Hierarchical PINNs are compared with Vanilla PINN, tuned gradient boosting, support-vector regression, and Gaussian-process regression on a heat equation and three heterogeneous two-phase-flow benchmarks. Experiments use 20--1000 labelled states and ten paired seeds. Each label is one coordinate--state observation, not a complete simulation. At least one PINN variant achieves the highest mean primary-target \(R^2\) in each interpolation and equation-assisted forecasting comparison at 20 and 50 labels. The advantage for water saturation persists across all tested budgets. Hierarchical weighting reduces variability across runs in selected settings. These results demonstrate that known physics can support accurate neural surrogate predictions from very few solution observations, at substantially higher fitting cost than the tested classical regressors.
items.title_ko: 소규모 데이터 환경에서의 물리 정보 신경망: 고전 PDE 서브로게이트와의 통제된 비교
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 물리 정보 신경망(PINN)이 제한된 레이블 관측에서 지배 방정식과 초기 및 경계 조건을 통합하여 정확한 예측을 달성할 수 있는지 조사합니다. 계층적 손실 가중치(H-PINN)와 그 기울기 방향 인식 확장(HO-PINN)을 도입하여 물리적 제약에 대한 강조를 조정함으로써 예측 정확도를 높입니다.
items.why_ko: 데이터가 부족한 공학 모델링 분야에서 PINN의 효율성을 입증하고, 예측 정확도를 높여 계산 과학 및 공학 문제 해결에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators
items.body: We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. To improve mode coverage we optionally utilize the well-tempered meta-dynamics framework, which also encourages exploration of the prior volume. We observe strong performance on standard SBI benchmarks, particularly when the prior volume is increased relative to the ground truth posterior, achieving a performance degradation of only $\sim5\%$ on Two Moons under a highly constrained simulation budget. Additionally, we evaluate RSBI's performance for gravitational wave ring-down posterior estimation, in a real-world physics benchmark inspired by black hole spectroscopy.
items.title_ko: 미분 가능한 시뮬레이터를 이용한 2단계 고속 시뮬레이션 기반 추론
items.summary_ko: Rapid Simulation Based Inference(RSBI)는 슈뢰딩거 브리지(SB) 확산 샘플링을 기반으로 하는 우도 없는 베이즈 추론을 위한 확산 기반 변분 접근 방식입니다. 이는 큰 사전-사후 볼륨 하에서 높은 샘플링 효율성을 달성하며, 초기 우도는 미분 가능한 시뮬레이터를 통한 거리 측정을 통해 제공됩니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 모델의 베이즈 추론 효율성을 크게 향상시켜, 과학적 발견 및 모델링 분야의 발전에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Path-Level Structural and Semantic Alignment for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification
items.body: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.
items.title_ko: 계층적 다중 레이블 텍스트 분류를 위한 경로 수준 구조 및 의미 정렬
items.summary_ko: 계층적 다중 레이블 텍스트 분류(HMTC)는 레이블 간의 구조적 의존성과 계층 수준별 미세한 레이블 의미를 모두 포착해야 합니다. 기존 방법은 주로 예측 제약이나 개별 레이블 및 지역 관계의 표현을 통해 계층 구조를 모델링하지만, 이 연구는 완전한 루트-노드 레이블 경로를 구조 및 의미 정렬을 위한 공유 단위로 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 계층 구조를 가진 텍스트 분류 작업의 정확도와 효율성을 높여, 문서 분류, 지식 그래프 구축 등 다양한 NLP 애플리케이션에 유용할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Optimal Rates for Adaptive Private $k$-PCA
items.body: Given $n$ i.i.d. random matrices $A_i \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ with common expectation $Σ$, the goal of \emph{Differentially Private Stochastic PCA} is to identify a $k$-dimensional subspace capturing the leading variance directions of $Σ$, while preserving differential privacy~(DP) for each individual sample $A_i$. \citet{dungler2025iterative} introduced \kdppca, the first algorithm to simultaneously (1) achieve sample complexity $n=\widetilde O(d)$ for sub-Gaussian data, (2) adapt its privacy noise to the intrinsic randomness of the data, and (3) extend seamlessly to any target dimension $k\le d$. However, its sample complexity has a suboptimal dependence on $k$. We propose the first algorithm that achieves optimal sample complexity in both $d$ and $k$, while retaining properties (2) and (3) of \kdppca. Additionally, prior utility guarantees require a minimum sample size with exponential dependence on the eigengap. Our method removes this dependence. It also improves the dependence on spectral parameters, matching known lower bounds for the spiked covariance model. Unlike deflation-based approaches like \kdppca, our algorithm updates the full $d\times k$ subspace jointly rather than one eigenvector at a time. This non-deflation structure simplifies the algorithm, reduces the number of hyper-parameters, and improves computational efficiency, particularly when using block linear algebra libraries.
items.title_ko: 적응형 프라이빗 k-PCA의 최적 속도
items.summary_ko: Differentially Private Stochastic PCA의 목표는 각 개별 샘플에 대한 차등 프라이버시(DP)를 유지하면서, 공통 기대값 Σ를 가진 n개의 i.i.d. 랜덤 행렬로부터 Σ의 주요 분산 방향을 포착하는 k-차원 부분 공간을 식별하는 것입니다. 이 연구는 서브-가우시안 데이터에 대한 표본 복잡도 n=O(d)를 달성하는 동시에 프라이버시 예산을 적응시키는 최초의 알고리즘인 kDPPCA를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 데이터 프라이버시를 보존하면서도 주성분 분석의 효율성과 정확도를 유지하는 방법을 제공하여, 민감한 데이터 분석 분야에 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: llm-gemini 0.36
items.body:
Release: llm-gemini 0.36

Gemini 4 Carbon was announced two weeks ago for "a subset of cyber defenders", but today it's available to everyone else.

This is Google's best ever Gemini, priced at $2/million input and $10/million output at launch (that's GPT-6.1 Sol / Claude Sonnet 5.5 prices) but scheduled to double in price to $4/$20 on December 1st (same as Opus 5.5).

Here are three pelicans for the low, medium and high thinking efforts (it defaults to medium). This is the pelican I got for high:

Gemini pelicans have all been great for a while now, so I also tested it out using Google's Antigravity IDE with a prompt I first tried with Claude Fable 5.2 yesterday:

Make a three js animation where yonkers stands up as a big mech (cool stand up motion) and stomps around manhattan and queens and Brooklyn, use openstreetmap mapping data
